title: Sinkhole Rush
description: You are a sinkhole in a busy city, and everything smaller than you is on the menu. Swallow people, cars, buses, houses, skyscrapers and even the stadium. In Battle mode, 8 holes compete for 2 minutes: bigger holes swallow smaller ones, so run from danger and hunt the weak. In Solo mode, eat as much of the city as you can for 3 stars. Earn coins, unlock 9 hole skins and grow from a tiny Crack into a Black Hole!
instructions: Mouse: move the cursor, the hole follows it. Touch: drag anywhere to steer. Keyboard: WASD or arrow keys, P or Esc to pause.

title: Besties Sunset Scooter Rider
description: Besties Sunset Scooter Rider is a fun and fashionable dress-up game where best friends set off on an exciting scooter ride during a beautiful sunset. Create stylish outfits that perfectly match the warm evening atmosphere as the girls explore scenic roads, enjoy the fresh breeze, and capture unforgettable moments together.
instructions: Left Mouse button click or Tap to play

title: Pythagoras Mahjong
description: Pythagoras Mahjong is a classic tile-matching puzzle with a mathematical twist. Instead of pictures, every tile shows a number or an expression: 3, √9, 1+2, 6/2 – all of them are equal, so they make a pair. Clear the board by matching free tiles with the same value and train your mental math while you relax.
instructions: Click or tap a free tile, then click another free tile with the same value to remove the pair. A tile is free when nothing lies on top of it and at least one of its left or right sides is open. Numbers and expressions with equal results match, for example 4, √16 and 2+2. Clear all tiles to win. Stuck? Use a hint or shuffle the free tiles.

title: Tile Sort: Color Columns
description:
This is an engaging logic game with colorful tiles. Your goal is to sort them so that each column contains tiles of a single color. Choose a column, add a tile to the top, and take the bottom tile for your next move. To solve each puzzle, think carefully about where every tile will go.
There's no need to rush: there is no timer and you can't lose, so you can take your time with every move.
instructions:
The tile at the bottom of the screen is the one you need to place. Choose a column: the tile is added to the top, and the bottom tile from that column becomes the tile for your next move.
Move tiles between columns until each column contains tiles of just one color. Plan ahead: the tile you take from the bottom determines your next move.
Some levels introduce hidden tiles and other mechanics. If you don't see a solution right away, try a different sequence of moves.

title: Sort Right
description: Sort Right is a relaxing colour-and-memory puzzle. Bottles are placed in a row, and you have to put each one in the right spot. Start with a few bottles and a clear target. Later levels hide the pattern, so you have to remember it. Tap CHECK to see how many bottles are correct, adjust your guesses, and clear the level with as few tries as you can. Earn stars and coins, and use hints when you're stuck.
instructions:
1. Tap a bottle in the tray, then tap an empty slot to place it. Watch the pattern at the top for the order to match.
2. On memory levels the pattern hides once you place a bottle, so remember it first.
3. Tap CHECK when every slot is filled. The ✓ counter shows how many bottles are in the right place, and the ↻ counter tracks your wrong attempts.
4. Use coins to buy hints if you're stuck, or watch a short ad to get more coins.

Controls: mouse click or touch.

title: Food Jam
description:
Welcome to a fun cooking puzzle!
Step into a busy kitchen where every order counts. Tap, sort, and match 3 identical items to prepare dishes for waiting customers. Manage your tray space, complete orders, and keep the line moving.
Travel through new levels, unlock foods, and test your logic and speed.
Relax or challenge yourself as you organize, match, and serve your way to kitchen mastery!
instructions:
Tap the conveyor belts at the bottom to move food items into the center tray.
Match 3 identical items to pack them.
Serve the correct food to customers in line and keep the orders flowing.
Be careful — don’t fill up the tray!

title: Froggee
description: Tap and jump to reach as high as possible. Collect stars and eat flies for points. Avoid dangerous animals and plants. Jump into a bubble to fly.
instructions: Tap and jump to reach as high as possible. Collect stars and eat flies for points. Avoid dangerous animals and plants. Jump into a bubble to fly.

title: Abyss Muncher
description: Dive into a colorful underwater roguelite where every meal makes you stronger. Hunt smaller creatures, dodge dangerous predators, and evolve your own build with mutations, skills, and relics. Explore changing ocean maps, unlock new creatures, and invest your rewards in permanent upgrades for the next dive.
instructions: Desktop: WASD to swim, Space to use your innate skill, and J/K/L for acquired skills. Use the mouse to choose upgrades and navigate menus. Mobile: drag to swim and tap the on-screen skill buttons. Eat smaller creatures, avoid stronger predators, and choose evolutions as you grow. Follow the guided first dive to learn the basics.

title: Candlebound Coven
description: Candlebound Coven is a top-down survivor-like about a witch's cat baking her way through five Halloween dreams. Rites fire on their own — a bell, a candle wisp, a frost halo, a purifying chime — and you only steer Mina and choose which one levels up.
instructions:
Desktop: WASD or the arrow keys move Mina. Your rites fire by themselves.
Mobile: drag anywhere on the field to steer.
When you level up, pick one of three cards. Survive each dream's full clock to open the next one; a fallen run can be revived once.

title: Cakefoot
description: Cakefoot is a precision avoider game where you use a single button to walk your cake as far as you can along a line, while obstacles like spikes, bombs, fire, and fish try to eat you. Easy to learn - press the button to walk forward, and let go to walk backward - brutally hard to defeat. 22 levels between you and the end of the line. You're live against the world with real time in-game leaderboards. Do you have what it cakes to put your name on top?
instructions:
* Hold left-click, any key, gamepad button, or touch to walk forward, and let go to walk backward.
* Beat levels and collect coins to unlock emojis. Beat the game and collect all coins to unlock more, including visual effects, and a faster but heavier cake on the third difficulty.
* Click your name on the title screen to edit your name and emoji.
* Turn off shaders from the pause menu if the framerate is dropping.

title: Camo Hunt
description: Camo Hunt is a cozy hidden-object puzzle where the hiders painted themselves to match the scene. Zoom into cluttered rooms and gardens, spot the little eyes, and find every Splotch before time runs out. Five worlds with 20 levels each, a Halloween event, a Daily Hunt, an endless mode, 40 skins, and a code you can share so a friend can find you. No sign-in, no violence.
instructions: Touch: drag to move around the scene, pinch to zoom, tap a hider to catch it. A wrong tap costs a few seconds. Mouse: drag to move, mouse wheel or the + and - buttons to zoom, click a hider to catch it. Keyboard: + and - zoom, arrow keys or WASD move, P pauses, 1 / 2 / 3 use the Magnifier, Eye-Ping and Freeze hints. Look for the eyes: hiders blink now and then.

title: Lanternfall
description:
Your home star is dying. Ambushed by pirates and thrown through a wormhole, you crash-land on Hearth III with nothing but your wits.

Get your ship back, explore a living galaxy of 30,000 stars and find the four keys that can relight Hearth before its light goes out.
instructions:
Keyboard

WASD or arrow keys: fly, drive or walk
Space: fire, stun creatures, booster during landing
E: interact (dock, land, enter buildings, talk, choose)
Q: scan / autopilot to next planet
M: hyperspace and star map
H: hail other ships
G: board a disabled ship
V: raise your shield
O: leave or enter your rover
R: fly your ship over a planet
A: autoland
1 to 6: pick dialogue options
Mouse and touch

Hold to steer or walk towards your finger
Tap the on-screen buttons for all actions

title: Obby: Supercar Race on Keyboard
description: Drive across giant keyboard keys in a colorful car parkour adventure! Collect cars, train to increase your speed, and tackle challenging tracks filled with obstacles. Complete stages, earn wins, and unlock new zones with tougher challenges. Discover powerful supercars and helpful pets, then rebirth to gain permanent bonuses and progress faster. Simple controls, bright visuals, and plenty of upgrades make every run a new challenge.
instructions: Desktop: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the mouse to look around, Space to jump, and the mouse wheel to zoom. Mobile: Use the on-screen joystick to move, drag to rotate the camera, and use the on-screen jump and zoom buttons. Train to gain speed, complete obstacle courses, and spend your wins on new cars.

title: Sweet Cakes
description: TAP AND DRAW WITH YOUR FINGER. MATCH 3 OR MORE OF THE SAME ITEM. TAP AND USE REWARDS TO CLEAR EVEN MORE ITEMS. USE THE KEY TO UNLOCK THE LOCKS. THE BETTER SCORE THE MORE REWARDS YOU WILL RECEIVE.
instructions: TAP AND DRAW WITH YOUR FINGER. MATCH 3 OR MORE OF THE SAME ITEM. TAP AND USE REWARDS TO CLEAR EVEN MORE ITEMS. USE THE KEY TO UNLOCK THE LOCKS. THE BETTER SCORE THE MORE REWARDS YOU WILL RECEIVE.

title: SWAT: Squad Tactics
description: Lead a tactical squad through intense top-down shooter missions. Rescue hostages, clear dangerous rooms, outsmart armed enemies, and restore order in chaotic locations. Choose your gear, move fast, aim carefully, and use smart tactics to survive every operation.
instructions: On PC, use WASD to move and LMB to aim, shoot, and interact during missions. On mobile, swipe to move your squad and tap to aim, shoot, select actions, or use objects. Clear each area, defeat enemies, rescue hostages, and complete the mission.

title: Hose Down
description:
Fight fires, save lives and ride the recoil! In Hose Down your fire hose is your extinguisher, your brake and your
jetpack: aim down and spray to fly over the rooftops. Answer 40 handcrafted calls across eight districts, from
sunset streets and neon hotels to snowy lodges, waterworks and a burning meltdown skyline. Knock down spreading
flames, rescue people and pets, dodge falling debris and open fire doors with valves, counterweights, pressure
plates and bank shots off steel deflectors.
instructions:
Move with A/D or the arrow keys, jump with Space/W. Aim with the mouse and hold the left button to spray; spray
downward to fly. Shift braces, E rescues and flips breakers, Q swaps jet and foam, P or Esc pauses. On touch: the
left stick moves, the right stick aims and sprays. Gamepads are supported.

title: Candy Swipe
description: TAP AND DRAW WITH YOUR FINGER. MATCH 3 OR MORE OF THE SAME ITEM. TAP AND USE REWARDS TO CLEAR EVEN MORE ITEMS. USE THE KEY TO UNLOCK THE LOCKS. THE BETTER SCORE THE MORE REWARDS YOU WILL RECEIVE.
instructions: TAP AND DRAW WITH YOUR FINGER. MATCH 3 OR MORE OF THE SAME ITEM. TAP AND USE REWARDS TO CLEAR EVEN MORE ITEMS. USE THE KEY TO UNLOCK THE LOCKS. THE BETTER SCORE THE MORE REWARDS YOU WILL RECEIVE.

title: Sharky Attack
description: Get ready for thrilling underwater action! Finish each round with a full belly and unlock up to 10 different sharks, each with unique abilities. Explore the ocean and feast on 30 different types of fish. Collect coins and trophies and most importantly, stay alive!
instructions: Your mission is to eat as many fish as you can in just 60 seconds. At the end of each round, earn coins and trophies. Spend coins to unlock power-ups that boost your shark's speed, strength and invincibility. Use trophies to unlock new stages and face even bigger challenges!

title: Arrow Go
description: Arrow Go is a relaxing puzzle game where every move matters! Untangle the arrows and clear the entire board by tapping them in the correct order. Each arrow can move only in its own direction, so make sure its path is clear before you tap. Plan ahead, avoid blocked moves, and remove all the arrows to complete the level!
instructions:
Tap an arrow to make it move in the direction it points.
If another arrow blocks its path, it cannot move.
Remove the arrows in the correct order to untangle the puzzle.
Clear all arrows from the board to complete the level.

title: ASMR Halloween Makeover
description: Give Dracula a spooky-to-glam makeover! Clean and pamper her with satisfying ASMR treatments, from removing stains and unwanted hair to relaxing back and body care. Then finish the transformation with stylish hairstyles, spooky makeup, cute accessories, and fabulous Halloween outfits. Complete the makeover and bring Dracula back to her human form!
instructions: Use MOUSE / TAP to play the game.

title: Scopa
description: Play Scopa, one of Italy’s most beloved card games, and test your strategy, memory, and quick thinking. Challenge your opponent, capture cards, and score points by collecting coins, the settebello, primiera, and decisive Scopas. Every move matters, so choose your cards carefully. With simple rules and smooth gameplay, Scopa is perfect for both experienced players and newcomers. Enjoy this Italian classic anytime, directly on your device!
instructions: Scopa is played in turns. Each player plays one card from their hand. You can capture one or more cards from the table if their total value matches the card played. If you cannot capture, your card stays on the table. Capturing all table cards in one move makes a Scopa and earns an extra point. At the end, points are awarded for most cards, most coins, the settebello, primiera, and Scopas. Play wisely and outscore your opponent!

title: Rewind House
description: Remember cassette tapes, gel pens and flip phones? Rewind House is a relaxing sorting puzzle full of 90s nostalgia. Sort four matching items onto each shelf, earn stars and restore your cozy childhood bedroom and kitchen. Raise a little pet, collect memory stickers and enjoy calm lo-fi music.
instructions: Tap or click a shelf to pick up the top items, then tap another shelf to drop them. Fill every shelf with four matching items. Use Undo or + Shelf if you get stuck.

title: ONE MORE
description: Play as a blue orb trapped in a dangerous arena. Collect valuable loot, earn points and unlock powerful upgrades while red enemies chase you from every direction. The greedier you become, the more dangerous the game gets. How much loot can you collect before the swarm catches you?
instructions:
Desktop: WASD or Arrow Keys to move.
Mobile: Touch and drag to control the blue orb.
Collect loot, avoid red enemies and survive as long as possible.

title: Hook A Brainrot
description:
Hook A Brainrot is a collection and survival game where every throw of your hook can bring you a new Brainrot, but catching one is only the beginning. The real challenge starts when a giant tsunami appears behind your catch!

Throw your hook into the field, pull a random Brainrot out of the ground, and quickly drag it toward the Safe Zone before the wave reaches it. Bring your catch back to your Base, add it to your collection, and let your Brainrots continuously generate money for you.
instructions:
Player 1 Controls
W, A, S, D: Move
TAB or E: Throw Hook
S: Pull Hook
F: Train Muscle
Shift: Speed Up
E: Interact

Player 2 Controls
Arrow Keys: Move
U: Throw Hook
Down Arrow: Pull Hook
Right Shift: Train Muscle
K: Speed Up
O: Interact

title: Vacuum.IO
description:
Vacuum.io is a fast-paced robot vacuum game with arena battles and cleaning missions.

In Arena Mode, collect trash and household items to grow bigger, absorb larger objects, and compete against other robots.

In Mission Mode, clean rooms in homes and schools. Complete each task to unlock the next room and progress through new areas.

Collect, grow, and become the ultimate robot vacuum!
instructions:
Desktop Controls
- Mouse / A-D / Arrow Keys: Move
- Hold Left Mouse Button / W / Up Arrow: Boost

Mobile Controls
- Touch & Drag: Move
- Hold with a Second Finger: Boost

title: Pet Fashion Stylist
description: Every pet deserves a second chance to shine! Rescue neglected pets, give them a relaxing spa treatment, clean their fur, and transform them with fashionable clothes and accessories. Capture the perfect photo, share it on social media, collect tons of likes, and challenge other players for the highest fashion score. Can your pet become the next internet superstar?
instructions: Use MOUSE / TAP to play the game.

title: Kick The Buddy
description: Relieve your stress and unleash your creativity in this ultimate interactive action game! Kick the Buddy is the perfect browser game for anyone looking to unwind after a long day. If you have ever wanted to smash, punch, or explode something without any real-world consequences, this is the free game for you. Dive into a satisfying playground where you interact with a resilient ragdoll buddy using an arsenal of creative tools.
instructions: or the mouse controls, you simply click on Buddy to hit him. You can also click and drag to stretch him, throw him around or shake him. The scroll wheel or arrow keys sometimes let you rotate the view depending on the version.

title: Puppy Paw Match
description: The park is full of adorable puppies and your mission is to play with them! Use your logic, make clever combinations and activate power-ups to complete each level. Discover special events like Hit the Box, Coin Catch and Time Attack as you advance on your exciting canine adventure!
instructions: Connect three or more puppies or their toys of the same type to complete each level. Detonate bombs or head to the Shop to choose from four special boosters to secure your progress. Play daily to earn rewards or spin the lucky wheel for even bigger prizes!

title: Merge and Harvest
description: Build a thriving market, one merge at a time! Combine matching fruits, vegetables, and farm goods to discover new products. Complete customer orders, earn coins, and unlock more space on your board. Discover new production stations, plan your moves, and turn a handful of fresh produce into a bustling market!
instructions: Use your mouse or touchscreen. Click or tap production buttons to create items. Drag two identical items together to merge them into a higher-level product. Complete customer orders to earn coins, then unlock more board spaces and production stations. Keep some spaces free to continue creating and merging!

title: Jewel Coloring: Crystal Sorting
description:
Welcome to Jewel Coloring: Crystal Sorting — a relaxing puzzle game where colorful crystals gradually transform into beautiful sparkling pictures.
Sort the gems by color and place them into the matching cells. With every correct move, the image becomes brighter and more complete. Simple controls, satisfying gameplay, and a calm atmosphere make each level enjoyable and easy to play.
instructions:
1. Pick sparkling diamonds and sort them by color.
2. Move each diamond into the matching cell on the board.
3. If the right spot is temporarily unavailable, use the storage area.
4. Plan your move order to avoid cluttering the board.
5. Use hints and boosters whenever you need a quick breakthrough.
6. Fill all cells correctly — and watch the picture shine in full beauty!

title: 2048 Bubble Shoot
description: 2048 Bubble Shoot combines bouncing ball action with the classic 2048 merging mechanic. Fire balls into the field, hit numbered blocks and watch them bounce around the board. Collect the balls through the pipe and merge matching numbers to create higher values. Aim carefully, use ricochets to your advantage and keep increasing your score!
instructions: Aim and shoot balls from the cannon into the playing field. Balls bounce off walls and objects, damaging or interacting with numbered blocks along the way. When balls enter the pipe, matching values can merge into a higher number. Plan your shots, create useful ricochets and keep merging numbers to reach higher values and earn the best score.

title: A7 Parking Puzzle
description: Guide your scooter through a charming tile-based puzzle world, collect keys, unlock gates, and reach the finish in as few moves as possible.
instructions: Guide your scooter through a charming tile-based puzzle world, collect keys, unlock gates, and reach the finish in as few moves as possible.

title: Maldito Botín
description: A pirate action-platformer with a debt problem. Captain Nico must storm ten cursed islands, beat their bosses and win back his ship. Collect 15 weapons and combine them (ice + shotgun, acid + fire, harpoon + Tesla), build bridges and cannons from scrap, find hidden treasures, recruit a crew and upgrade your ship between voyages.
instructions: A/D or arrows: move. Space: double jump. J: fire. K: bomb. E: build with 3 parts. S: crouch. Q: switch weapons. Tab: backpack. F: interact. Esc: pause. On mobile use the on-screen buttons.

title: Dreamland Survivors
description: Survive endless monster hordes in a pixel-art dreamland! Move, dodge and dash — your weapons fire on their own. Collect XP, level up and pick upgrades to craft a build that grows stronger every minute. At 10:00 the boss arrives: defeat it and step through its portal to carry your whole build into the next land — from the Dreamland Plains to the icy Frostlands and the haunted Forgotten Crypt. Earn Silver after every run to unlock new heroes, weapons, items and permanent upgrades.
instructions: Move: WASD / arrow keys, drag anywhere on touch, or the left stick. Dash: Space / Shift (gamepad A, or the DASH button on mobile). Weapons attack automatically. Pick upgrade cards with the mouse, keys 1-3 or a tap. Open chests and enter portals with E. M shows the map, Esc / P pauses.

title: Puzzle Jewels
description: TAP AND DRAW WITH YOUR FINGER. MATCH 3 OR MORE OF THE SAME ITEM. TAP AND USE REWARDS TO CLEAR EVEN MORE ITEMS. USE THE KEY TO UNLOCK THE LOCKS. THE BETTER SCORE THE MORE REWARDS YOU WILL RECEIVE.
instructions: TAP AND DRAW WITH YOUR FINGER. MATCH 3 OR MORE OF THE SAME ITEM. TAP AND USE REWARDS TO CLEAR EVEN MORE ITEMS. USE THE KEY TO UNLOCK THE LOCKS. THE BETTER SCORE THE MORE REWARDS YOU WILL RECEIVE.

title: Halloween Match
description:
Match spooky creatures and build your own Halloween collection. 
Click or tap on the creature and it will float upwards. Two matching creatures merge and disappear.
instructions:
Tap or click on creature bubbles to float them up.
Stack 2 of the same type next to each other and they will pop! The goal is to pop all of them.
Watch out, they can get stuck on the way up. But you will have tools to help in tough situations.

title: Catch Them All
description:
Welcome to Catch Them All!, a relaxing and addictive match-3 puzzle game where adorable cats are waiting to be caught!

Match identical items, clear the board, and catch as many cute cats as you can. With simple controls, satisfying combos, and a variety of challenging levels, the game is easy to pick up but hard to put down.

Whether you have a few minutes to spare or just want to relax after a long day, jump in and start catching!
instructions:
Match three or more identical pieces.

Clear the board by making smart matches.

Create combos to clear more pieces and achieve higher scores.

Complete the level objectives to catch the cats.

Keep playing and see how many cats you can catch!

title: Monster Chef
description: Monster Chef is an exciting cooking game that mixes funny robot monsters with fast-paced restaurant challenges. Step into the kitchen as a monster chef and keep up with moving ingredients, cooking machines, and hungry robot customers. With its easy controls and lively kitchen action, this Simulation game delivers a fun Casual kitchen management experience for those who enjoy quick decisions and busy cooking tasks.
instructions: Tap to play.

title: Drople
description:
Roll a ball down tall pixel-art levels, dodging spikes, saws, water, swinging blades and flame vents. The clock stops only at the altar at the bottom, and every death costs you time.

75 levels across three worlds, each with three stars to earn: a time to beat, a death limit, and a coin hidden off the safe path. Spend the coins on new ball skins. And there is a daily drop: one new level every day, the same for every player.
instructions: Roll with the arrow keys or A/D, or the on-screen buttons on mobile. Jump with Space, W or the up arrow, and hold it for a higher jump. Touch a crystal to save a checkpoint; Backspace sends you back to it. Reach the altar at the bottom as fast as you can, and look for the coin hidden off the safe path.

title: Ultimate TicTacToe
description: Ultimate TicTacToe is a strategic twist on the classic tic tac toe game. Play across nine mini boards, send your opponent to specific boards with every move, and win three mini boards in a row to claim victory. Simple to learn, tactical to master, and perfect for quick puzzle battles.
instructions: Choose a game mode and place your symbol on an open cell. The cell you choose sends the next player to the matching mini board. Win mini boards by making three in a row, then win the match by claiming three mini boards in a row. If the target board is already full or won, you may play on any open board.

title: Crown & Conquest
description: Crown & Conquest is a single-player strategy game where you lead a kingdom across a contested map. Choose a campaign, send troops between cities, and capture enemy territory. Click or tap cities and the on-screen controls to issue orders. Drag to explore the map; use the mouse wheel or pinch with two fingers to zoom.
instructions:
Desktop: Click cities and buttons to give orders. Drag to move the map and use the mouse wheel to zoom. WASD or arrow keys move the map; 1/2/3 select 50/80/100% of troops; R rallies troops; Space or Esc pauses.

Mobile: Tap cities and buttons. Drag with one finger to move the map and pinch with two fingers to zoom.

Capture rival cities while defending your own.

title: Galaxy Shoot
description: Galaxy Shoot is a hyper-casual arcade game designed to test your absolute focus and timing. You will oversee a central turret that continuously auto-rotates, facing targets that are also constantly moving in orbit.
instructions: Gameplay requires only a single tap. Tap anywhere on the screen to fire exactly when the gun's barrel points directly at the passing target.

title: Golfdash
description:
Golfdash is an arcade game that merges the thrills of golf and puzzles. Navigate a golf ball in a maze-like golf course to its goal. There are 30 levels filled with fun cryptic puzzles. Do you think you have what it takes to beat the game?

Only one way to find out!
instructions:
On Desktop/PC:

-Use the WASD or ARROW keys to move.

W or UP ARROW to move up.

A or LEFT ARROW to move left.

S or DOWN ARROW to move down.

D or RIGHT ARROW to move right.


On Mobile:

-There are on-screen controls for mobile.

Use the LEFT BUTTON to move left.

Use the RIGHT BUTTON to move right.

Use the UP BUTTON to move up.

Use the DOWN BUTTON to move down.

title: Definitely Not a Platformer
description: Definitely Not a Platformer is a puzzle-platforming game where appearances cannot be trusted. Cross 20 handcrafted stages filled with invisible paths, fake platforms, collapsing floors, shifting colors, surprise hazards, misleading signs, and a narrator who may or may not be helping you. Learn each level’s rules, spot the clues, and reach the exit while improving your completion times and death count.
instructions: Move with the Left and Right Arrow keys or A/D. Q/D is also supported for AZERTY keyboards. Jump with Up Arrow, W, Z, Space, or a mouse click. On mobile, use the on-screen Left, Right, and Jump buttons; you can also tap the game area to jump. Press R to restart, M to mute, and Escape or P to return to the menu. Reach the portal at the end of each stage, but do not trust every platform or sign.

title: Crazy Chess: Forest Adventure
description: Crazy Chess: Forest Adventure is a fast-paced fantasy chess battle where classic chess meets HP-based combat, unique abilities, wild movement, power-ups, and dramatic K.O. battles. Play in 2 Player mode with a friend or challenge the computer across multiple difficulty levels. Move units, attack enemies, manage HP, trigger powerful events, and defeat the enemy boss. Explore a colorful forest battlefield, master unique units, and experience chess like never before!
instructions:
Choose a game mode: 2 PLAYER to play locally with a friend, or VS COMPUTER to challenge the AI with different difficulty levels.

Select a piece and tap a highlighted valid move. Each piece has unique movement and HP-based combat. Attack enemies, use abilities and power-ups, survive battle events, and defeat the enemy boss to win.

Use Settings to change theme, day/night mode, music, and sound. Desktop: Mouse controls. Mobile/Tablet: Tap pieces and move locations.

title: Car Sort
description: Car Sort is a colorful parking puzzle game. Tap a garage to send its front cars onto the road, then match cars with garages of the same color. Plan your moves, keep an eye on road capacity, and clear each level. Use helpful boosters when you need more space or a fresh arrangement. Play with a mouse or touch controls. Progress is saved in the current browser.
instructions: Desktop: Left-click garages and interface buttons. Mobile: Tap garages and interface buttons. Sort cars into matching garages and keep the road from filling up.

title: Bus Jam : Sort Escape
description: Clear the traffic in Bus Jam - Sort Escape, a colorful single-player puzzle with 1,000 levels. Tap available buses to pick up passengers of the same color, manage limited road spaces, and merge three matching buses into a double-decker. Plan each move, use Clear, Shuffle and Magnet boosters when needed, and unlock pixel-art collections as you progress. Play with a mouse or touch controls. Progress is saved in the current browser.
instructions: Desktop: Left-click buses and buttons. Mobile: Tap buses and buttons. Send buses to collect passengers of the same color, keep road spaces available, and combine three matching buses. Use the on-screen boosters when you need help.

title: Fruit Rush
description: Are you fast enough to follow the fruit? Match the patterns with lightning speed to keep your streak alive and your score climbing. When things get sticky, tap your Special Boosters at the bottom of the screen to trigger epic chain reactions and crush your personal best. It’s fresh, it’s addictive, and it’s ripe for the picking! Play now and show off your skills.
instructions: Match the patterns with lightning speed to keep your streak alive and your score climbing. When things get sticky, tap your Special Boosters at the bottom of the screen to trigger epic chain reactions and crush your personal best. It’s fresh, it’s addictive, and it’s ripe for the picking! Play now and show off your skills.

title: Pipe Line Puzzle: Tea
description: Settle in by the fire for a slow, warm puzzle. In Pipe Line Puzzle, every board is a little wooden tray of enamel pipes. Rotate the pieces to connect them and send tea from the teapot through the glass-windowed pipes into every cup on the table. No drop spilled, no cup left empty.
instructions:
Tap or click a pipe to rotate it 90°.
Connect the pipes so tea flows from the teapot into every cup, with no open ends spilling.
Finish before the candle burns out. Use as few moves as possible to earn 3 stars.
Stuck? Use Undo, Restart or a Hint (the bulb button).
Brass-pinned pipes can't be turned; use them as clues.
Keyboard: Z undo · R restart · H hint · V 2D/3D view · Esc pause

title: Chaindrop
description: Aim, drop, and watch one ball ricochet through a field of glowing pegs. Every peg it clips raises your multiplier, so one long bounce beats a dozen short ones. Clear each round's target before your balls run out, then pick one of three upgrades (bigger balls, bouncier shells, bombs, gold pegs, low gravity) and face a tougher board. Gold pegs boost the multiplier, bombs blast nearby pegs, and green pegs give free balls.
instructions: Mouse: move to aim, click to drop. Touch: hold and drag to aim, release to drop. Keyboard: Left / Right arrows to aim, Space to drop, M to mute.

title: Octobeer
description: Octobeer is a fast-paced arcade throwing game where every mug counts! Aim, throw, and smash waves of flying enemies while building combos and earning coins. Survive 20 increasingly wild runs, pay your rent, unlock crazy mug styles, collect hats and trophies, and discover special throws that make your beer bounce, curve, home in, orbit, grow giant, and more. Manage your coins wisely, keep your beer stocked, and fight your way to become the Octobeer Legend!
instructions:
Desktop: Hold the left mouse button, move horizontally to aim, then release to throw.
Mobile: Touch and hold, slide horizontally to aim, then release to throw.

title: ASTRO MARGE
description: Merge falling planets, create combos, and build the biggest stack! The pressure keeps rising, so think fast and beat your high score.
instructions: Move your mouse or finger to aim. Click or tap to drop a planet. Merge matching planets to grow your stack and score higher!

title: Bubble Pop Frenzy
description:
Bubble Pop Frenzy is a fun and addictive bubble shooter game with a creative twist. Aim, match, and pop bubbles to clear levels and create satisfying chain reactions. Earn rewards as you progress and use them to decorate beautiful rooms, adding a relaxing and personal touch to your adventure.

With smooth controls, colorful visuals, and hundreds of levels, the game is easy to learn but challenging to master. Enjoy quick sessions or longer play anytime. Start popping and build your dream space!
instructions:
Desktop:
- Mouse Click: Aim and shoot bubbles

Mobile:
- Tap & Drag: Aim
- Release: Shoot

Match 3 or more bubbles to pop them and clear the board.

title: Virtuoso: Virtual Piano
description: Become a piano legend in Virtuoso! Play timeless hits from Beethoven, Mozart, and Chopin in this addictive rhythm game. Tap the keys in perfect time with the falling notes to create beautiful music. Features 5 difficulty modes from Novice to Symphony, stunning 3D graphics, and responsive controls. Can you master the keys and unlock every song? Play now on mobile or desktop!
instructions:
How to Play:
Desktop: Use your mouse to click the falling notes or press the corresponding keys on your keyboard (D, F, G, H, J, K).
Mobile/Tablet: Tap the screen directly where the notes fall.
Goal:
Hit the notes exactly when they reach the bottom line to score points.
Timing matters! Aim for "Perfect" hits to build your Combo and get the highest score.
Avoid missing notes to keep the music playing beautifully.

title: Cozy Jigsaw
description: Piece together stunning images in this cozy and relaxing, brain-teasing challenge. The ultimate digital jigsaw experience.
instructions: Drag and drop pieces using your mouse or touch to snap them into place.

title: Night Lake
description: A calm night on a quiet lake: row your little boat by lantern light, cast your float and wait for the bite. Night Lake is a relaxing fishing game with a touch of mystery. Catch perch, pike, carp and giant catfish, sell your catch at the dock and upgrade your rods, reels, lines and baits. Explore a growing collection of lakes, from a moonlit forest lake to a jungle bayou, frozen shores and a ruined mill pond, and discover the strange, legendary creatures said to live in the deep.
instructions: Desktop: W/S to row, A/D to turn. Hold Left Click on the water to aim and release to cast. Click or press Space when the float goes under, then hold to reel in; keep the tension out of the red and use A/D to lean the rod. E opens the dock shop at the dock, P pauses. Mobile: left stick to row, right stick to aim, cast, strike and reel.

title: Loom Rush
description: Loom Rush is an arcade game where you draw loops around swarms of blobs to pop them. The more blobs you catch in one loop, the bigger the multiplier. Blobs chase you, and every touch costs a life. Red cutters bounce around and snap your trail. After each wave, pick one of three upgrades. Between runs, spend sparks on permanent boosts.
instructions: Hold the left mouse button and move to draw a trail. On mobile, touch and drag. Close the trail into a loop around blobs to pop them all at once. More blobs in one loop means a bigger multiplier. Blobs chase you and cost a life on touch. Red cutters snap your trail, so keep them away from it.

title: The Three Tiles in the Halloween World
description: Welcome to "The Three Tiles in the Halloween World" – a captivating Match-3 puzzle game filled with vibrant tiles and brain-teasing challenges! Immerse yourself in a world of colorful trials and satisfying matches that will keep you entertained for hours.
instructions:
1) Look for matching tiles to collect them.
2) Matching sets of three will be removed from the board.
3) Clear the whole field to beat the level.

title: Free Cell Solitaire
description:
The Goal: Build four HomeCells by suit in ascending order (Ace to King).

The Rules:

    Move: Shift the bottom card of any column to a FreeCell to uncover the cards beneath.

    Build: Move cards between columns in descending order with alternating colors (e.g., a Red 9 on a Black 10).

    Empty Spaces: Any card can fill an empty tableau column—use these spots wisely to maneuver!

    The Win: Keep moving cards one by one until all suits are stacked in their HomeCells.
instructions: The Goal: Build four HomeCells by suit in ascending order (Ace to King).

title: Infinity Sky
description: Guide your bouncing hero up endless platforms! Dodge monsters, collect rewards, and see how high you can climb in this addictive vertical jumper.
instructions: Desktop: Click the left/right screen halves, or use A/D and Arrow keys to move. Mobile: Simply tap the left or right side of your screen to jump!

title: DESCENT
description: DESCENT is a downhill mountain-bike time trial. One mountain, . kilometres of hand-routed trail and metres of vertical drop: berms, rock gardens, root sections, jump lines and a final sprint. The bike is simulated for real — progressive fork and shock, per-wheel grip, load transfer, pumping and air control. Read the trail, carry speed through the berms, keep the wheels on dirt, and take down your personal best split by split. Chase the clock in Timed Runs or explore the hillside in Free Ride.
instructions: Keyboard: W/S or arrows — pedal and brake, A/D — lean, Space — pump/jump, R — restart, Esc — pause. Gamepad is supported. On the descent, braking before a corner and leaning through it is faster than dragging the brakes. Pump the backsides of rollers to gain speed without pedalling. Crashes cost seconds, not the run — get back on and finish. The default track is the ranked one: only it feeds the leaderboard.

title: LugRush
description: Get your suitcase through the airport, onto the right plane, and back off it at the other end. Swipe to dodge trolleys, oil spills and other luggage, pick the right belt at every split, and reach the gate before it closes, then guide your bag through baggage claim. 700 real airports in 187 countries, each with its own difficulty.
instructions: Desktop: Left / Right arrow keys or A / D to switch lanes, P or Esc to pause. Mobile: swipe left or right. At every split take the belt showing your flight number and city. Four scuffs and the bag bursts.

title: Wordloft: Balloon Crossword
description: Wordloft is a crossword where the letters float in on balloons. A bunch of balloons hangs below a mini crossword: pop the balloon with the right letter and it flies into the cell. Solve 100 crosswords in 10 themes — Home, Animals, Journey, Nature, City, Jobs, Sports, Music, Kitchen, Capitals — and travel across the map in a hot-air balloon. Earn stars, spend them on the Wind that clears the wrong balloons, and enjoy a calm word game with no timer.
instructions: Read the clue at the top. Tap the balloon with the letter that fits the highlighted cell — the letter flies into the crossword. Tap any cell to fill it out of order; tap a wrong (red) letter to remove it. Fewer mistakes mean more stars. Use the light bulb for a hint or the Wind to blow away the wrong balloons.

title: swingpit
description: swingpit is a one-tap precision game. A gorilla swings on a rope over a bottomless pit. Tap to let go, fly, and land as close to the centre of the next platform as you can. Perfect landings score big. Miss, and it is a long way down. Every stage changes the rules: heavier gravity, wind, shrinking platforms, ropes that snap. Modes: Casual (three lives), Ranked (one life, daily seed, leaderboard, streak) and Multiplayer royale (up to 100 players, last one standing wins). No accounts.
instructions: Tap, click or press space to let go of the rope. One button. Works in portrait and landscape.

title: Patient Zero: Escape
description: Patient Zero: Escape is a relaxing block-placement puzzle game set in a stylized 3D hospital. You are patient Zero — every patient order in your form is a puzzle board you must clear. Pick up the shapes, fit them into the empty slots, and fill every cell to cure the ward and move on.
instructions:
How to play:
- Drag (or tap) a piece to move it; tap/click to rotate where offered
- Fill the board completely to complete the level
- Use P or Escape to pause, and the pause menu to return to the menu or adjust sound

title: Twin Catch
description: Twin Catch is a one-touch arcade reflex game where a single control moves two mirrored paddles. Mint Mina guards the left half, pink Pino guards the right, and every slide sends them in opposite directions. Catch the falling orbs on both sides to build a combo and multiply your score up to 5x. Grab golden stars for bonus points, shields to survive one miss, and hearts to win a life back. The speed climbs the longer you last, so keep both halves alive and beat your best run.
instructions: Move your mouse, drag your finger, or use the Arrow keys (or A and D) to aim. One control moves both paddles at once, but they mirror each other: slide left and the left paddle goes left while the right one goes right. Catch every falling orb on both sides. A miss costs a life and three misses end the run. Chain catches to raise your combo multiplier. Collect gold stars for bonus points, blue shields to block one miss, and pink hearts to restore a life. Press Escape to pause.

title: Snow Rider Neo
description: Carve through snowy forests and mountain slopes in Snow Rider Neo, a fast-paced 3D endless sledding game. Dodge trees, rocks, snowmen and rolling snowballs, time your jumps over logs and gaps, and ride ramps as the downhill run gets tougher. Clear skies can give way to snowfall and blizzards. Choose from three sleds with different handling, collect gifts to unlock new paint finishes, and beat your best distance. Play with keyboard controls on desktop or on-screen buttons on mobile.
instructions: Desktop: Use Left/Right Arrow keys or A/D to steer. Press Space, Up Arrow or W to jump. Press Esc or P to pause/resume. Mobile: Hold the on-screen left/right buttons to steer and tap JUMP to jump. Tap the pause button to pause.

title: Screw Sort Master
description: Screw Sort Master is the ultimate satisfying puzzle experience! Tap colorful screws to sort them into matching slots — fill a slot with 3 same-colored screws and watch them burst away in a satisfying pop! With procedurally generated endless levels, combo multipliers, and that perfect ASMR feel, you'll keep coming back for "just one more level." Stuck? Watch a rewarded ad to free a slot and keep going! Play anywhere — no download needed, one tap to start.
instructions:
TAP any screw on the board — it flies into a matching collection slot at the bottom.
MATCH — screws stack in slots of the same color. Each slot holds up to 3.
CLEAR — fill a slot with 3 same-colored screws and they explode! Clear all screws to win the level.
Tips: Plan your moves wisely — once a slot takes a color, it's locked to that color. Run out of moves? Watch an ad to continue or use undo!

title: Merge Land
description: Discover countless objects to merge, from delicious plates of food to tropical treasures like pebbles and shells. Merge, build or restore run-down buildings, unlock vibrant tropical locations, meet new characters and help them transform their world with your special touch.
instructions: Move and merge identical pieces on the board to complete tasks. Earn experience points to unlock new levels with more buildings to restore. Progress through levels, earn rewards and use special items like the Joker to merge with any piece and speed up your journey.

title: Bongo Bounce
description: Bongo Bounce is a musical arcade game where every bounce plays the beat. Keep a bouncy slime in the air with your drum, hit the bumpers in time, and the soundtrack builds itself as your groove climbs. Land perfect hits to trigger Fever, collect notes, unlock new slimes and drum kits, and chase a higher score every run.
instructions:
Slide the drum left and right to keep the slime from falling.
Mouse or finger: drag anywhere on the screen to move the drum.
Keyboard: arrow keys or A / D.
Hit the slime with the middle of the drum for a Perfect and your groove goes up. The higher the groove, the fuller the music and the bigger the score. Miss and you lose a heart. Level up mid run to pick a boost.

title: Big Smash
description:
Aim your tennis balls at a tower of cubes on the table and knock the whole lot down. Stone, wood, ice, jelly... every
cube falls differently!
instructions:
Objective
Bring down the tower. 

CONTROLS

Computer:
- Click and hold to pull back the cannon, aim by dragging, and release to fire.

Phone or tablet:
- Tap and drag to pull back and aim, then lift your finger to fire.

title: Cosmic Ace
description: Cosmic Ace is a fast 3D space combat survival game. Pilot your jet through escalating invasion waves, aim with the mouse, burn nitro to boost, collect nanocores for mid-run upgrades, and unlock aircraft and weapons in the hangar. How long can you survive as invasion pressure rises?
instructions:
Desktop: Move the mouse to aim. Use WASD or arrow keys to fly. Hold Shift (or the boost key) for nitro. Defeat waves, pick upgrades when prompted, and survive as long as you can.

Mobile: Use the on-screen joystick to move and the boost button for nitro. Aim by dragging. Tap Play to start.

title: Driftline
description: Driftline is a relaxing fishing and base-building game on a living sea. Start on a small raft, catch fish and salvage treasures, then sell your haul and craft better equipment. Grow your floating home through five base stages, complete fish bounties, and fill your collection. Changing weather and time of day bring new discoveries. Restore a skiff to explore farther waters. Progress saves automatically in your browser.
instructions: Desktop: Click a walkable platform to move. Hold Space or drag on the water to aim, then release to cast. Press when a fish bites. Hold to reel and release when tension gets high. Click nearby facilities to use them. Right-drag to look around. Mobile: Play in landscape mode and use the on-screen movement and fishing controls. Tap facilities to interact. Open Settings for sound, graphics, language and save backups.

title: Cube Snake 2048
description: Cubes 2048.io is an addictive online game that fuses Snake and 2048. Get a bigger number by collecting free cubes and eating other players with a smaller number than you. Your cubes with the same value that bump into one another will merge.
instructions:
Merge blocks to grow
Cubes 2048 turns 2048 into a 3D .io game! Slide around the arena picking up blocks to get bigger. Picking up two of the same number will merge them into a single block as the total sum of both.

title: Hustle & Drift in ZIL
description: In this game, you need to deliver cargo while keeping it firmly on the truck. But delivering safely isn't enough—you've got to do it with style! Slide your ZIL into drifts to rack up more cash for every delivery.
instructions:
PC Controls:

Arrow keys and/or WASD – Drive / Vehicle control
Spacebar – Handbrake
"C" key – Change camera view
"Shift" key – Nitro / Boost
"T" key – Toggle drift mode
"P" key – Next music track
Mouse – Camera look / Look around

Mobile Controls:

On-screen buttons

title: Mermaid Castle Adventure
description: Mermaid Castle Adventure is a magical underwater adventure game where mermaids explore a cursed castle, rescue trapped friends, collect treasures, and rebuild their beautiful ocean home. With simple exploration and charming missions, the game is a fun choice among casual games for kids and an enjoyable dress-up game experience.
instructions: Tap/Drag to play.

title: Harvest Glam
description: Glam is the ultimate fall-themed makeup and dress-up game where cozy vibes meet high fashion! Create stunning autumn looks using warm palettes, golden highlights, and stylish seasonal outfits. Mix earthy tones, layered hairstyles, and rustic accessories to craft the perfect fall aesthetic. Celebrate sweater weather with endless glam possibilities in this cozy-chic makeover adventure!
instructions: Use your mouse to play this game on a desktop, tap to play on mobile devices.

title: Snack Stack
description: Snack Stack is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle set in a colorful Asian food market. Pick tasty food tiles from the board, collect matching snacks, and complete each level’s goal. Plan your moves carefully as the board gradually opens up, and enjoy satisfying matches with fish, steak, corn, eggs, crab, and more.
instructions: Tap an available food tile to move it into the tray at the bottom. Collect 3 identical tiles to match and remove them from the tray. Keep matching tiles to reach the level goal and clear the required items. Be careful — the tray has limited space, and if it fills up before you can make a match, you lose. Use Undo or Shuffle when you get stuck.

title: Marble Maze
description:
Roll. Dodge red. Reach green.
Guide a glossy marble through wild worlds where danger comes disguised as decoy holes, spinning blades, moving walls, and toxic blobs. Grab coins, chain power-ups, and ride a hot streak into GOLD RUSH. Unlock skins, chase stars, and see how far "one more level" takes you.
instructions:
Desktop: Use WASD or the Arrow keys to roll the marble. Hold Shift to boost. Press R to restart, Enter or Space to confirm, and Esc or P to pause.

Mobile: Tilt your device to steer, or drag on the screen to move. Hold BOOST to speed up.

title: Stick Fix: Matchstick Puzzle
description: Every equation on the table is wrong, and you only get one or two matches to fix it! Pick up a matchstick, drag it to a new spot and watch the numbers change: a 6 becomes a 5, a minus turns into a plus. Solve it and every match bursts into flame. 250 puzzles across 5 worlds, a Daily Puzzle, Time Attack and over 100 matchstick skins to collect.
instructions: Tap or click a match to pick it up, then tap an empty spot to place it (or drag and drop it). In "add" puzzles tap an empty spot to add a match, in "remove" puzzles tap a match to remove it. Use Undo, Reset and Hint below the puzzle.

title: Hexshot ARENA
description: HEXSHOT ARENA is a first-person voxel hero shooter where building and destruction are part of the fight. Raise cover, mine through walls and pick one of ten classes, each with its own weapon, two abilities and an ultimate. Battle across nine arenas in team deathmatch, free-for-all, round-based elimination, control points and payload escort. Play solo against bots or online with up to ten players.
instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys and press SPACE to jump. Aim with the mouse, hold the left mouse button to fire and use the right mouse button for your alternate fire. SHIFT and E trigger your two class abilities; Q fires your ultimate once it is charged and unlocked at level 6. Press C to place blocks, F to mine blocks or strike in melee, R to reload and B to toggle the building preview. Hold TAB for the scoreboard and press P to pause. Gamepads are supported.

title: Cute Animals
description: Get ready for a paws-itively addictive puzzle experience! Dive into a world of vibrant colors, charming characters, and heart-pounding matching action. This isn't just a game—it’s a sensory journey where every move you make brings a burst of joy!
instructions: Master the Match: Use your lightning-fast reflexes to tap, drag, and align three or more identical items. Watch in awe as they vanish in a spectacular, juice-splashing explosion!

title: Twilight Mahjong Manor
description: Match tiles to bring back a manor lost to a curse. Enjoy spooky mahjong with haunting charm. Clear classic layouts pair by pair, earn resources, and rebuild the manor piece by piece. Ghosts, bats, and black cats haunt every tile, and an eerie twilight mood hangs over every board. Stuck on a tricky layout? Shuffle, hint, and undo keep every game moving.
instructions: Match two identical spooky tiles to remove them from the board. A tile is free when no tile is on top and at least one side is open. Clear all tiles to complete the layout and earn resources for the manor. Use Hint, Shuffle, Undo, or Show Free Tiles when needed. Every layout you complete brings the cursed manor one step closer to its former glory.

title: Road Fury - Racing
description:
Dive into dynamic 3D racing where your main goal is to reach the finish line first. The track is full of rivals, dangerous obstacles, traps, ramps, and sharp turns that will test your reaction speed and driving skills.
Every collision damages your car: the body breaks, wheels can fly off, and handling becomes harder. Use nitro, avoid hazards, upgrade your vehicle, and buy new cars to become the race leader.
instructions:
Goal:
Reach the finish line first while overtaking rivals, avoiding obstacles, and escaping traps. Avoid collisions, use turbo, and upgrade your car to win the race.

Controls:
Mobile devices: use touch and swipes to control the car.
PC: WASD — control the car, double-tap W — turbo.

title: CuboMunch 2048
description:
CuboMunch 2048 combines snake-style movement with 2048 merging in a fast-paced 3D arena.

Collect numbered cubes, merge matching values, and grow your colorful chain while avoiding stronger rivals. Create chain merges, climb toward bigger numbers, and see how far you can reach.

Start small and grow toward 2048 and beyond.
instructions:
Desktop
Move the mouse: Steer
Hold the left mouse button: Boost

Mobile
Touch and drag with one finger: Steer
While steering, hold a second finger on the screen: Boost

title: Scribble Slash
description: Your pen is your weapon! Draw on the notebook page to slash, lasso and zap waves of scribbled monsters. Every shape does something different: slash through monsters, draw a circle to lasso a whole group, scribble a zigzag for lightning, a spiral for a tornado, a triangle for a shield, or tap for an ink bomb. Pick power cards as you level up, beat giant bosses like the Paint Golem, the Ink Dragon and the Spider Queen, and travel through new worlds. How long can you survive the scribble storm?
instructions: Hold and drag (mouse or finger) to draw. Swipe through monsters to slash them. Draw a circle to lasso, a zigzag to zap, a spiral for a tornado, a triangle for a shield, and tap for an ink bomb. Press P to pause.

title: Happy Fox
description:
Dive into a vibrant world of puzzles with this addictive casual slide-match adventure! Join the Happy Fox on a quest to collect precious items across hundreds of unique levels.

With intuitive tap-and-slide mechanics, it’s easy to pick up but hard to put down. Sharpen your strategy: finish your targets within the move limit or race against the clock to secure a high score and earn three stars. Perfect for quick breaks or hours of fun—happy sliding!
instructions:
Match: Tap and slide items to connect identical objects.

Target: Collect the specific items shown in the goal counter.

Efficiency: Complete objectives before moves or time run out.

Score: Finish fast to earn bonus points and a higher star rating!

title: Gravity Glitch
description: Gravity Glitch is a one-button neon runner. Tap to flip gravity and run on the floor or the ceiling while you dodge spikes, pits, walls and spinning saws. Flip pads, flip rings and glitch gates add new twists across 30 levels in three worlds: Neon City, Cyber Factory and Void Core. Collect coins to earn up to three stars per level, unlock 11 skins, and see how far you get in Endless mode.
instructions: Tap the screen, click, or press Space, W, S or the Up/Down arrow keys to flip gravity. You can flip only while standing on the floor or ceiling, except inside flip rings, where you can flip in mid-air. Avoid spikes, saws, walls and pits. Flip pads flip you automatically and glitch gates swap you to the other side. Press Esc or P to pause.

title: Reversi Evolved
description: This classic strategy game, featuring a variety of exciting gameplay variants, transforms every match into a unique experience. Built around the traditional 8×8 grid and the original rules players know and love, it emphasizes strategic thinking, smart positioning, and the ability to anticipate your opponent’s moves, creating a balanced experience that is easy to learn but challenging to master.
instructions:
Mobile
tap one of the available tile to place your stone and make a move

Desktop
use your mouse, click one of the available tile to place your stone and make a move

title: Snaking.io
description: The more snakes you eat, the bigger and stronger you become! Earn gold as you progress and upgrade your powers. Unlock new snakes, explore challenging stages and satisfy your hunger. Are you ready for this epic slithering adventure!
instructions: Control your snake with smart moves, devour smaller snakes and grow bigger. Earn gold as you progress and spend it to boost your speed, power and resistance. Collect trophies, unlock 10 unique snakes and discover new stages.

title: ArrowXis Brain Escape Puzzle
description: Arrowxis Puzzle Game is a fun and addictive brain puzzle where logic and strategy lead to victory. Solve unique puzzles by removing Arrowxis pieces in the correct order across three exciting challenge modes. Enjoy hundreds of handcrafted levels, relaxing gameplay, satisfying chain reactions, and progressively challenging puzzles that train your mind without time limits.
instructions: Simply tap an Arrowxis piece with a free tail to remove it. Depending on the selected challenge mode, matching colors, directions, or all free pieces may disappear automatically. Plan each move carefully, create chain reactions, and clear every puzzle using intuitive touch controls. Easy to learn, yet rewarding to master.

title: Farm Blast 2
description: Farm Blast 2 brings a fresh new look and more fun to the colorful farm puzzle adventure! Blast groups of juicy fruits, complete different level goals, rescue adorable farm animals, and deal with new obstacles along the way. Enjoy updated graphics, lively farm locations, satisfying combos, and increasingly challenging levels. Plan your moves carefully and discover new ways to clear the board in this cheerful and addictive blast puzzle game.
instructions: Tap groups of 2 or more adjacent fruits of the same type to blast them from the board. Check the targets at the top of the screen and complete them before you run out of moves. Blast larger groups to create powerful boosters and clear more tiles at once. Some levels feature animals and special obstacles that require different strategies to complete the objective. Use your moves and boosters wisely to finish each level and continue your farm adventure.

title: Cat arrows: Cozy Puzzle
description: Guide adorable cats through cozy mazes, untangle tricky paths, use helpful hints, unlock charming skins, and solve clever logic puzzles across hundreds of relaxing levels
instructions: Tap or click an unblocked cat to send it moving in the direction it faces. Choose the correct order and clear every cat from the board. Drag to move around the board, and use the mouse wheel or a pinch gesture to zoom.

title: Backrooms Craft
description:
Backrooms Craft is a first-person survival and building game set in the endless yellow corridors of the Backrooms. Mine walls, floors and furniture block by block, craft tools, torches and weapons, and build a shelter you can light and defend.

Explore flooded poolrooms, humming server halls, offices and warehouses. Things live between them: some only watch, some follow. Mind your health, hunger and torch batteries, and remember that only what you build inside the start zone is kept.
instructions:
Desktop: WASD to move, Space to jump, Shift to run, C to crouch, E for the inventory, J for the journal, Esc for settings. Hold the left mouse button to mine a block, right mouse button to place, use or drink. In the bag, right click takes half a stack.

Mobile: the on-screen stick walks, push it out to run, and the pads jump and crouch. Hold on a block to mine it, tap to place, use or hit. The BAG button opens the inventory and the MENU button opens settings.

title: K-Pop Halloween Dress Up
description: Get spooky and stylish with K-Pop Halloween Dress Up! Dress the K-Pop girls in hauntingly chic outfits like Witch, Pumpkin Queen, Vampire Idol, and more. Mix costumes, accessories, and spooky face paint to create bold Halloween looks for your favorite idols. Show off your fashion skills and celebrate Halloween K-pop style in this fun dress up game!
instructions: Use your mouse to play this game on a desktop, tap to play on mobile devices.

title: Sea Battle Multi player
description: Join the lobby and play against your friends. Amazing and fun battle game. Shoot your opponents fleet with torpedo’s, triple bomb’s or airstrike from the sky. Get cool rewards when finding treasures. Buy more items in the shop and defend your pride as a captain at war. Placing target and viewing attacks continues until one player's fleet has been sunk or all lives are lost.
instructions:
Amazing and fun battle game. Shoot your opponents fleet with torpedo’s, triple bomb’s or airstrike from the sky. Get cool rewards when finding treasures. Buy more items in the shop and defend your pride as a captain at war.

1. Setup your fleet 
Tap an item to arrange Tap and drag to place 
Tap to rotate item
Tap green check mark
  
2. Start attack 
Tap and drag to place your target

3. view the actual attacks

Be aware of time limits.

title: Pixel Nono
description: Pixel Nono turns simple number clues into a quiet, rewarding moment of focus. Fill the grid, mark the empties, and watch a pixel-art picture appear, one logical step at a time.
instructions: Solve number clues, fill the grid, and reveal a hidden pixel-art picture.

title: Shoot the Bubbles
description: Aim, shoot, and match 3+ bubbles of the same color! Take on hundreds of levels in Adventure mode or see how long you can last in endless Challenge Mode. Special bubbles and explosive combos await!
instructions:
Desktop: Move the mouse to aim, then left-click to shoot. Use the walls to bounce shots and reach difficult groups.

Mobile: Drag your finger to aim, then release or tap to shoot. Use the walls for angled bounce shots.

title: Pop Flower
description: Pop Flower is a relaxing and colorful sorting puzzle game. Each bubble holds different flowers, and your goal is to pick the right flowers and place them into flower pots. Match three identical flowers in one pot to clear them and complete each level.
instructions:
How To Play

Tap a bubble to choose a flower inside it.

Place the selected flower into the matching flower pot.

Collect three of the same flower in one pot to make them disappear.

Plan your moves carefully, clear the flowers, and unlock new levels with more flower combinations.

title: Bestie’s Y2K Butterfly Trends
description: Bestie’s Y2K Butterfly Trends brings the playful and colorful style of the early 2000s back to life with a fresh fashion makeover. Step into a nostalgic world of butterfly prints, cute crop tops, mini skirts, trendy accessories, and dreamy Y2K-inspired looks.
instructions: Left Mouse button click or Tap to play

title: Ghosty Bubble
description:
Match 3 bubbles to drop them!
Drag to aim, then release to shoot!
Fill the slot pot with bubbles to activate the slot.
Hit the jackpot to blast out tons of bubbles!
Clear obstacle bubbles before they cover the pot!
Collect treasures from the gacha machine and unlock higher-scoring bubbles!
instructions: Drag to aim, then release to shoot.

title: Hex Mine 3D
description: Hex Mine 3D is a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game where every move matters. Explore beautiful spherical hex worlds, clear the correct tiles, and solve carefully designed levels with logic, focus, and precision.
instructions: Rotate the hex globe, study the tile layout, and choose your moves carefully. Clear the correct hex tiles to complete each level. Think ahead, avoid mistakes, and master every pattern.

title: Prisma: Tide of Colors
description: Unwind by the sea in Prisma: Tide of Colors, a colorful screw puzzle with translucent glass pieces and satisfying physics. Remove accessible screws, match three of the same color in the trays, and plan around a limited reserve. Work through 40 handcrafted levels, earn coins, and unlock helpful tools and permanent finishes.
instructions: Click or tap an accessible screw to remove it. Collect three screws of the same color in a tray to clear them. Plan your moves so the five reserve slots do not fill up. A piece swings when only one screw remains and falls when all its screws are removed. Clear every screw to complete the level. Use Undo, Hint, and your tool case when you need help.

title: Ninja Platformer Rage
description:
Master your ninja skills in a challenging platformer where every jump matters!

Run, jump and overcome 50 handcrafted levels filled with traps, obstacles and unexpected challenges. Use your shadow to reach places you normally can't, then teleport back to it at the perfect moment.

Some levels will test your reflexes, others your precision — and some might completely mess with your sense of scale and perspective.

Can you beat all 50 levels?
instructions:
PC
- A / D or Arrow Keys — Move
- Space — Jump
- Shift — Throw Shadow
- Double Shift — Teleport to Shadow


Mobile
- Left / Right — Move
- Jump — Jump
- Shadow — Throw Shadow
- Dash — Teleport to Shadow

title: Fruit Box Sort
description: Sort colorful fruit boxes in a relaxing puzzle game. Tap open boxes to send fruit onto the conveyor belt and fill matching containers. Plan your moves, keep space on the belt, and discover 210 levels with mystery boxes, fruit barrels, ice and linked boxes. Use helpful boosters when you need a hand. Progress is saved in your browser.
instructions: Desktop: left-click boxes and buttons. Mobile: tap boxes and buttons. Choose an accessible fruit box, match fruit with the containers below, and avoid filling the conveyor belt.

title: Zipzap
description: ZipZap is a fun and challenging number-path puzzle game where players connect numbers in the correct order to complete each puzzle. Choose from Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty modes, solve 63 levels in each mode, improve your best time and score, and challenge yourself with daily puzzles.
instructions: Start by selecting number 1, then use the mouse, touch controls, or keyboard arrow keys to move through the grid and connect the numbers in the correct order. Complete the path without making mistakes. Use hints when needed and try to finish each puzzle as quickly as possible.

title: Strike Bullet
description: Strike Bullet is a ricochet puzzle shooter. Aim carefully, bounce your shot off metal walls, and take out every enemy. Plan your angle, watch the trajectory, and clear 20 levels packed with challenge!
instructions:
Desktop Controls:

Mouse: Aim by moving the cursor.
Left Click: Fire your bullet.
R: Restart the current level.

Mobile Controls:

Touch & Drag: Aim by dragging on the screen.
Release / Tap: Fire your bullet.
Restart Button: Restart the current level from the in-game UI.

title: SNACK & WARP
description: Eat apples, grow and solve 67 colorful puzzles! Lift crates, send them through portals and use buttons to change your route. Blade apples split your worm into two equal halves: switch between them to hold doors, support crates or stop saws. Plan your bites and leave room for your tail. Collect every apple, meet the goals and guide either worm to the purple exit. Enjoy free undo, three-star challenges and optional video hints. No timer!
instructions: Arrow keys / WASD: move. On mobile, swipe or tap the arrows. Q or 1 / 2: select a worm; you can also tap it. Z: undo. R: restart. H: video hint. Esc: menu. Collect all apples, meet button/crate goals and guide either worm into the purple exit. Only crates travel through the paired portals.

title: Sky Golfer
description: Sky Golfer is a physics-based puzzle game where your objective is to guide a golf ball from a starting point to the hole. The golf ball rests on a complex structure made entirely of flat, interconnected platforms. Your primary mechanism for moving the ball is to rotate the entire platform structure either clockwise or anti-clockwise by set increments.
instructions:
On Desktop/PC:
 -Rotate Left (Anti-Clockwise): Hold the Left Arrow key 
-Right (Clockwise): Hold the Right Arrow key

 On Mobile:
 -Simply tap and hold the on-screen buttons on the left or right side of the display to rotate the platforms in that direction.

title: Pixel Path 2
description: You'll play as Pixel Tadpole. You'll have to navigate twenty challenging levels. The difficulty increases with each level. You'll need to be attentive and agile to complete them all. Spikes, pits, and falling coconuts are just a few of the challenging challenges that await you. Your nervous system will need to be strong to successfully complete the levels. Only the most experienced players will be able to complete this game.
instructions:
PC controls:
A, D, Left Arrow, Right Arrow - character controls
Space - Jump

Mobile device controls:
Tap the on-screen touch game buttons

You need to reach the flag to complete the level.

title: Bubble Merge: Word Sort
description:
Discover a relaxing word puzzle where every move counts. Your goal is to sort word bubbles into their correct categories and clear the board using logic, observation, and vocabulary.

Features:

Simple controls with satisfying gameplay
Helpful boosters for challenging levels
Relaxing experience that exercises your brain
Play anytime, even without an internet connection
instructions: Use mouse drag and merge bubble to same category and clear them!

title: Ball and Maze
description: Roll your way to victory in Ball and Maze, a captivating physics-based puzzle adventure! Guide a rolling ball through intricate mazes by tilting or sliding it, collecting shiny stars along the path while avoiding dead ends and obstacles. The core idea is precise control and clever pathfinding—navigate tight corners, gather every star for maximum points, and reach the exit to conquer each level.
instructions:
PC Controls:
Mouse: Click and drag/slide on the screen to tilt or move the ball in the desired direction.
(Alternatively, use arrow keys if supported for precise tilting.)
Mobile Controls:
Touchscreen: Swipe or drag your finger on the screen to tilt the maze and roll the ball.
(Drag left/right/up/down to control direction and momentum.)

title: Candy Sort
description: Candy Sort is a colorful sorting puzzle where you move candies between tubes and group them by color. Place candies only in empty tubes or on the same-colored candy. Race against the clock, and when you need help, watch a short reward ad to add an extra tube or stop the timer for unlimited time.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to move candies between tubes. Place a candy in an empty tube or on top of a candy of the same color.

title: Tilt Merge
description:
Tilt Merge is a number puzzle with one extra move that changes everything.

Drop numbered blocks into five columns. Equal neighbours merge and double, and a block landing on two or three twins takes them all for extra points. Merges chain.

The twist is the tilt: swipe left or right and every row slides to that wall. Charges are scarce and refill as you merge, so each one is a decision.

No timer. Play endless for a best score, or the daily challenge - same blocks for all, 60 drops.
instructions: Tap or click a column to drop the block shown next to the board. Swipe left or right, or press the TILT buttons, to slide every row to that wall. The SMASH button removes any single block: press it, then tap the block. Keyboard: arrow keys or 1-5 choose a column, Space drops, Q and E tilt, P opens the menu.

title: Arrow Sand Puzzle
description:
Arrow Sand Puzzle combines arrow puzzles with colorful sand sorting. Tap an arrow with a clear path to send it out of the board and watch it turn into flowing sand. Fill the matching buckets below while keeping the conveyor belt from overflowing.

Think ahead, choose your moves carefully, and work through 100 levels. Use Hammer, Shuffle, and Clear boosters when you need a little help. Simple tap controls make it easy to start, while layered arrow layouts give you plenty to puzzle over.
instructions:
Desktop: Left-click an arrow to move it in the direction it points. Click a booster to use it.
Mobile: Tap an arrow or a booster. An arrow can leave only when its path is clear.

title: Scraps!
description: Place hex tiles and connect matching colours to score. Level a colour to earn a merge powerup. Nothing clears — the run ends when nothing fits.
instructions:
-Place Hex tiles on the grid
-Match same colors to gain points
-Level up each color score to get merge powerup
-Merge and clear space!

title: Cave Maze
description: Cave Maze is an atmospheric maze-exploration game. Guide your torchlight through a dark cave, collecting keys and embers before your fuel runs out. Avoid the wandering spirit that hunts you through the shadows, cross crumbling bridges carefully, and race the clock to reach the exit. Unlock new flame colors with coins earned in-game or from a quick rewarded ad.
instructions: Use arrow keys or swipe/tap to move through the maze — no complex controls needed.

title: Capybas
description: Capybas is a cozy logic puzzle game that blends the deduction of Minesweeper with the rule-based thinking of Sudoku. Find the hidden capybaras by using clues from colors, rows, columns, and adjacency rules. Complete levels, earn coins, and unlock new capybaras and themes as you progress through Easy, Medium, and Hard modes.
instructions: Choose a difficulty and start a board. Each color region hides exactly one capybara, and each row and column can also contain only one capybara. Capybaras cannot touch each other, even diagonally. Tap once to mark with an X the places where you think there are no capybaras, and double tap a square when you think a capybara is hidden there. Find them all before you run out of lives.

title: Brass Labyrinth
description: Brass Labyrinth is a slide-to-wall puzzle set on a warm walnut-and-brass desk toy. Flick the marble to glide until it hits a wall—reading the whole route ahead instead of crawling tile-by-tile. Navigate one-way brass gates, dodge pits, and collect all gems to unlock the exit hatch. Master 300 boards with 3-star ratings, using Undo, Hints, and custom marble skins.
instructions:
Move: Swipe or use WASD/Arrows. The marble slides continuously until blocked by a wall.

Gates & Hazards: One-way brass gates open only in the arrow's direction. Avoid pits or restart the board.

Goal: Collect all gems on the board to unlock the hatch, then roll in to complete the level.

Rewards: Finish in fewer moves for 3 stars. Use Undo or Hint (rewarded ads available) if stuck.

title: Knock It Down
description: A physics puzzle game about a demolition service: complete 120 orders across five districts with one slingshot, real destruction physics, six projectiles, upgrades, and precision stars.
instructions: Drag the slingshot ball back and release to fire. Choose a projectile using the ammo buttons. Complete each order's objective, earn stars and scrap, and buy upgrades on the map. Use Menu during a job to pause, restart, adjust sound or language, or return to the map. Play with a mouse or touch in landscape.

title: Klumen
description:
Filaments of light lie scattered and twisted apart. Tap a tile to turn it, and join every filament to its neighbour until light flows from the heart-star through the whole weave — and it wakes.

Hundreds of always-solvable puzzles that grow with you: obstacles, portals, one-way valves, linked gears, and prisms that mix two colours into a third. The music is made by the game as you play — slow notes that fade, never a loop.
instructions: Tap or click a tile to rotate it. Join every filament to its neighbour until the light flows from the star in the centre through the whole board. One thumb, no account, nothing to install.

title: Magic Slide
description:
Slide blocks to complete horizontal lines!
New blocks rise from the bottom each time you move a block.
Don’t let the blocks reach the top!
Clear blocks to fill the pot gauge and reveal diamonds.
Aim for a high score!
instructions: Drag to move blocks sideways.

title: Unite Words
description: Find groups of 4 related words and place them in the same row to complete a set. Swap words between rows to arrange them correctly. Some levels contain special sets that, when completed, reveal new words for you to group. Complete all the sets before the time runs out! If you get stuck, use a hint to highlight a group of words.
instructions: Use a mouse or touchpad to select and swap words between rows, then group 4 related words in the same row to complete a set.

title: BirdDuko
description: Every colour patch hides one bird. Work out where they're sitting! Birddoku is a calm logic puzzle: place one bird in each colour, never two in the same row or column, and never two touching, not even corner to corner. Boards start at a gentle 4x4 and grow to 9x9, with new levels that keep coming.
instructions:
Tap a square once to cross it out. Tap a crossed square again to place a bird. Tap a bird to remove it. Drag across squares to cross out several at once.
Rules: one bird per colour patch, one per row and column, and birds may not touch, even diagonally.
A wrong bird costs a heart; lose all 3 and the level restarts. Use Hint to reveal a bird and Undo to step back.

title: Berryflow
description: Drag through berries of one color and the juice pours into a glass. There are fewer glasses than colors, so mixing is unavoidable: pour top layers from glass to glass, drop a fizz tablet to foam away a layer, add syrup to blend colors, and bring every mocktail to one pure color. 70 levels across five worlds: chameleon berries, fuses, color bombs, ice and an order belt. No timers, one-hand play on phone and desktop. Every drink is a non-alcoholic berry mocktail.
instructions: Mouse or touch. Drag through 3+ adjacent berries of one color to pour their juice into the selected glass; longer chains give more juice.
