Tap a glass to choose where the juice goes; above it you see the target color and how much still fits. Drag from glass to glass to pour the top layer (only onto the same color or an empty glass). Fizz removes the top layer; syrup blends the two top layers. A glass is done when full with one color. Finish every target glass within the move limit.

title: Arrow Out
description: Arrow Out is a calm, satisfying puzzle game about reading the board. Every level is a shape built from dozens of tangled arrows. Tap an arrow and it slides off the board along its own path, but only if the lane ahead of its tip is clear. Tap a blocked arrow and it crashes, costing you a heart. Clear every arrow to finish the shape.
instructions: Tap or click an arrow to send it out. It only leaves if nothing blocks the lane in front of its tip. Scroll or pinch to zoom, and drag to move around the board. Use Hint, Bomb and Reveal when you're stuck.

title: Arrows Flow
description: Untangle winding arrows and clear the board in Arrows Flow. Each arrow can leave only in the direction it points. Find an open path, click or tap to send it away, and create space for the next move. Learn the controls through an interactive tutorial, then solve increasingly challenging boards with helpful power-ups. Play with a mouse or touch controls.
instructions:
Desktop: Click an arrow with the left mouse button to move it in the direction it points. Click the on-screen buttons to pause or use available power-ups.

Mobile: Tap an arrow to move it in the direction it points. Tap the on-screen buttons to pause or use available power-ups.

Find unblocked arrows and clear the board.

title: Arrow Slide
description: Arrow Slide is a satisfying grid-based puzzle where you tap colorful arrow tiles to slide them off the board. Each tile is shaped like a snake with an arrowhead pointing in one direction — tap it and the whole thing slithers along its path until it disappears off the edge. Clear every tile from the board to complete the level, but be careful — if a tile bumps into another and cannot exit, you lose a life.
instructions:
- Tap any arrow tile to slide it in the direction its arrowhead points
- Bent arrows slither snake-style — the body follows the head along its path
- A tile can only exit if its path is clear all the way off the board
- Tapping a blocked tile costs one life and bumps it back
- Clear every tile from the grid to complete the level
- Use Hint to reveal a safe move, or Eraser to remove a blocking tile
- You start with three lives — lose them all and it's game over

title: Cut the Nut
description:
Cut the Nut! Cut ropes, bounce objects, and use clever tricks to guide the nut safely into the squirrel's mouth. Each level brings new challenges that test your timing, creativity, and problem-solving skills.

With adorable animations, satisfying interactions, and tons of brain-teasing fun, Cut the Nut is a charming adventure for players of all ages. Can you help the squirrel grab every nut?
instructions:
PC: Use the mouse
Mobile: Tap to play

title: Arrows Disappear
description:
Rotate to inspect cube structures, tap blocks with arrows pointing to empty space to make them fly off-screen, clear the entire level to master puzzles.
Arrows on block faces dictate the only removal direction, plan sequence to avoid getting stuck; cute pink & green accent cubes, limited moves challenge your brain for addictive 3D dismantling satisfaction!
instructions:
PC Controls:
Mouse drag: Rotate to view cube.
Mouse click: Tap block with arrow to empty space to remove.
Mobile Controls:
Finger drag: Rotate 3D cube structure.
Tap block: Remove if arrow path is clear ahead.

title: 2048 Voxel Worlds
description: 2048 Voxel Worlds is the classic merge puzzle rebuilt in full 3D. Swipe to slide a whole board of lit voxel blocks, merge matching numbers and chase the target cube past 2048. Spend Swap, Blast and Rotate powers, earn coins on every merge, and unlock eleven worlds. Free, no download.
instructions:
GOAL: merge matching numbered blocks until you build the target tile. On a
4x4 board that is 2048, on 5x5 it is 4096, and on 6x6 it is 8192. You can keep
playing past it.

title: Ambidieztro
description:
Control two characters at the same time, one with each hand! Ambidieztro is a unique skill game that challenges your coordination and ambidexterity.
- 1 player, 2 characters
- Independent controls for each hand
- Both characters must collide to advance to the next level
- Boosts ambidexterity and bilateral coordination
instructions:
Left hand: controls character 1 (WASD)
Right hand: controls character 2 (arrow keys)
Restart: TAB

title: Blankets
description: Blankets is a relaxing yet addictive color sorting puzzle game where every match helps keep a chilly little cat warm and cozy. Match two squares of the same color to clear them from the board and make room for new ones. It starts easy, but every move matters as the board fills up and the challenge keeps growing. How long can you keep the board under control before it fills up?
instructions: Colored squares fall from the top of the board. Click or tap the lane where you want the current square to land, and it will drop into place. Plan your moves carefully to match colors and keep the board from filling up.

title: Needle in a Haystack
description:
Needle In A Haystack is a first-person 3D game about exactly what it says. In front of you is a
pile of 1.5 million straws of hay, and somewhere inside it are ten needles. Find them all as fast
as you can.

Walk into the pile and the world closes in: the hay surrounds you, the light dies, and
the only thing guiding you is a hot-and-cold detector that ticks faster the closer you get. Every
needle you find earns coins. Spend them with the merchant on cool powerups!
instructions:
WASD / Arrows
Click on the needle to collect them

title: PixelTris
description: A falling-block puzzle where every piece shatters into flowing sand. Bridge one colour wall to wall to clear it, then chain combos.
instructions:
HOW TO PLAY
• Blocks fall, then shatter into loose sand when they land
• Connect one colour of sand from the left wall to the right wall to clear it
• Clear again within 3 seconds to build a combo multiplier
• Sand piles up as you go — the run ends when there's no room for a new block

CONTROLS
• Move — Left/Right arrows, or A / D
• Rotate — Up arrow, W, or X
• Soft drop — Down arrow, or S
• Hard drop — Space
• Touch — drag to move, tap to rotate, flick down to drop

title: Arrow Parking
description: Arrow Parking is a relaxing puzzle game that challenges players to think ahead. Place arrow tiles to create the perfect route, guide the car to the garage, and solve increasingly challenging parking puzzles.
instructions:
How to play:

Desktop

Mouse: Drag and drop arrow tiles onto the board.

Mobile

Touch: Drag and drop arrow tiles onto the board.

title: Detective Ava: Logic Files
description: Step into the stylish world of Detective Ava: Logic Files! Read every clue, study the suspects, and use pure deduction to uncover the truth. Mark suspects as Possible or Not Possible, avoid costly mistakes, and solve 90 increasingly challenging cases. Use hints when you’re stuck and prove you have what it takes to close every case.
instructions: Read the clues carefully and compare them with the suspects’ visible features and names. Use the Tick button to mark a suspect as Possible and the Cross button to mark them as Not Possible. Make the correct final deduction to solve the case. You have 3 hearts per level; each mistake removes 1 heart. Lose all 3 hearts and the case ends. Use Hint if you need help.

title: Cocoon Crossing
description: Cocoon Crossing 3D is a relaxing 3D routing puzzle. Drag the head or tail of each caterpillar and it crawls, tile by tile, toward the cocoon of its own color — reach it and it turns into a butterfly. Worms can't cross on the same level, but at a crossing they can climb over a bridge or slip under a tunnel. Solve each board within the move budget, chase the par star, and untangle your way through dozens of handcrafted levels.
instructions: Drag the head or tail of a caterpillar to make it crawl one tile at a time toward its matching cocoon. Two worms can't overlap on the same level — at a crossing tile, send one over a bridge and the other under a tunnel. Get every worm home (they turn into butterflies) to win. Finish within the move budget; match par for a star. Use Undo to take back a move, or Hint when you're stuck.

title: Brain Jam
description: Brain Jam is a sliding car puzzle with one twist: it counts the calories your brain burns while you think. The parking lot is jammed. Slide the cars out of the way and drive the red one to the exit. Every second you spend thinking feeds a live calorie counter, and the longer you concentrate without moving a car, the faster it climbs. 120 hand-checked levels, plus a Daily Puzzle that is the same for every player in the world, so you can compare your result with friends.
instructions: Drag a car along its own lane to move it. Cars only slide forward and backward, never sideways. Clear a path and slide the red car out through the exit on the right. Stuck? Tap Hint and the game shows you the next useful move. Mouse: drag. Touch: drag.

title: 2048 Decks
description:
Drag, and the whole board shifts one cell — not as far as it can go. Two equal numbers double only when the tile in front has nowhere left to move, so every merge is one you set up.
Nothing is random. The tiles come off a written deck you can count, and the next three are already on screen, so a jam two moves away is one you can see coming.
Four decks: plain numbers, stones that block until you crack them, a wild that takes any value, and a board that grows with your biggest tile.
instructions:
Stack the numbers up. Do not fill the board.
Mouse and touch play the same: drag the board. Arrow keys and WASD work too. Z undoes. Escape or P pauses.

title: Tube Jam Puzzle
description:
Take control of colorful tube dispensers and master the flow of rolling balls in this unique conveyor puzzle challenge. Press and hold to release balls onto the moving belt, fill matching boxes, and keep the conveyor running smoothly.

But be careful! The conveyor has limited capacity. Release too many balls at once and traffic starts to build. Time your flow, switch between tubes, and prevent jams before the belt becomes overloaded.
instructions: Tap and hold the left mouse button on tubes to dispense the balls.

title: Turnline Atelier
description: Turnline Atelier is a tactile logic game about tuning a precision workshop. Rotate routing modules, send workpieces through paint, cutting, assembly, and packing stations, then run the line and watch the result. Master 15 handcrafted commissions across three chapters. Later orders ask you to preserve offcuts, synchronize branches, and assemble parts in the correct sequence.
instructions: Tap or click round routing modules to rotate them. Connect the source, required stations, and destination in recipe order, then press Run. On later levels, route both branches to their matching assembly sockets or parts bins.

title: ECHO
description:
Every move comes back. Drag a ball and it slides one square — then, every three
turns, every ball you have moved repeats its move. Forever. Balls smash gems of
their own colour, so you are never just solving a puzzle: you are building a
machine out of your own past, and then watching it work. Line several balls up
to strike on the same beat and the whole board goes off at once. 160 levels,
every one of them verified solvable before it shipped, plus a Daily Echo that
changes at midnight.
instructions:
Drag a ball to move it one square. Every 3 turns, EVERY ball you moved repeats
its move — the brass dial at the top counts down to the next beat. Balls break
gems of their own colour. Break them all before your moves run out.
Press WAIT to skip a turn and let your machine do the work. ERASE removes one
echo if you change your mind.
Desktop: drag with the mouse, or tap a ball and use the arrow keys; SPACE waits.

title: Hotpot Loop Sort
description: Food‑sorting puzzle challenge to test your reaction skills. Beneath its charming visuals lies a real brain workout. Plan your hotpot strategy, manage conveyor capacity and pull off perfect combinations. Sorting pushes your multi‑tasking skills to the limit. Loops speed up, more dishes pour in, and tension keeps rising
instructions:
Tap and flip ingredients, place them onto the conveyor belt.
Match ingredient hints from the hotpot and time your drop precisely.
Never overload the conveyor or place wrong items.
Adapt to more ingredients to beat levels.

title: Arrows: Relax Game
description:
Relax with a colorful minimalist puzzle that combines simple rules with engaging spatial challenges. Study the direction of every arrow, plan the correct sequence, and gradually clear the board.
There are no stressful timers, strict limits, or penalties, so every puzzle can be solved at a comfortable pace. Hundreds of unique levels range from easy warm-ups to clever brain teasers. Play on a computer or mobile device, sharpen your logic, and discover whether you can untangle every arrow!
instructions:
Examine the board and pay attention to the direction of each arrow. Select an arrow when its route is clear, then continue removing the remaining pieces in the correct order.
On a computer, use the left mouse button to select arrows. On a phone or tablet, tap the desired arrow with your finger.
There is no timer or penalty. Take your time, correct your strategy, and clear every arrow to complete the level.

title: Autumn Onet Connect
description: Welcome to Autumn Onet Connect, the ultimate cozy tile-matching puzzle game that brings crisp harvest vibes and golden autumn charm straight to your screen!
instructions: Click two identical tiles to match

title: Farm Triple Match 2
description:
Farm Triple Match 2 is a mahjong-inspired tile matching puzzle set on a farm of your own. Enjoy  brand-new artwork and more content than ever. Match tiles, clear boards, and turn an empty field into a farm of your own: cute animals, a blooming garden, a whole world that grows with you.
Easy to learn, but the boards get smarter as you go — a proper brain puzzle when the stacks pile up. Tiles feature fruits, vegetables, farm animals and more, across a growing collection of levels and locations!
instructions: Find three identical tiles and tap them one by one — they move to the collection row at the bottom of the screen, and a matching trio disappears. You can only pick up tiles that aren't covered by others, so plan ahead: if the collection row fills up, the level is over. Use boosters to clear space or shuffle the board when you're stuck. Play with your mouse or touchscreen.

title: Yarn Art Loop
description: Discover a fun yarn-sorting game you won’t be able to put down. Bobbins move along a conveyor belt, collecting strands of their own color. You’ll need to anticipate their movements, as each bobbin has a limited capacity. Are you ready to take on the challenge?
instructions: Place the correct bobbin on the belt and collect all strands of the same color from the outside in to complete each level. Overcome increasingly difficult challenges with faster speeds and more complex color combinations. Use power-ups to progress more easily.

title: Save My Human
description:
Step into the paws of a hero cat! Navigate tile by tile through tricky puzzles and dangerous paths to rescue your beloved human. Can you save your favorite owner?

It’s up to you, a brave little cat, to rescue your human!
instructions: Control the cat to save the human with your keyboard or UI Arrow

title: Prism Blast 3D
description: Prism Blast 3D is a fresh take on block puzzle — played on a round 3D board instead of the usual square grid. Drag blocks onto the rings, line them up to blast whole rings and spokes, and keep the creeping grey junk from closing in. Chain clears for combos, spend power-ups when you get stuck, and work through score, junk-clear and survival goals. Easy to learn, satisfying to master.
instructions: Drag a block from the tray onto the round board. Fill a whole ring or spoke to clear it. Press a cell to aim, release to blast (tap outside to cancel). Grey junk creeps in from the outside — only a blast clears it. Use the power-ups below the board: ↩ Undo, ? Refresh tray, ? Swap, ⏳ +5 Turns, ? Hammer (tap a cell to smash). Don't run out of room to place the next block.

title: Mellow Escape
description: Mellow Escape is a cozy puzzle game where you guide a small blue block through relaxing handcrafted challenges. Plan your moves, avoid obstacles, collect stars, unlock new skins and themes, and progress through increasingly challenging levels.
instructions: Use touch controls or the mouse to move the blue block through each puzzle. Plan your route, avoid obstacles and reach the goal to complete the level.

title: Sliding Maze
description: Sliding Maze is a satisfying roll-to-wall puzzle: pick a direction and your ball slides until it hits an obstacle. Collect every gem to unlock the goal, dodge the pits, and finish in as few moves as possible for bonus stars. Unlock new ball skins, build a daily streak, and lean on Undo or Hint when a level has you stuck.
instructions: Swipe or use arrow keys/WASD to send the ball rolling — it slides until it hits a wall. Collect every gem on the board to unlock the goal and clear the level. Falling into a pit sends you back to the start. Fewer moves earn more stars. Stuck? Use a Hint or Undo your last move.

title: Sweep Maze
description: Sweep Maze is a relaxing puzzle game where you guide the ball across the board and paint every open tile. Plan each move carefully, avoid blocked spaces, and complete the entire maze to finish the level. With procedurally generated boards and multiple difficulty levels, every puzzle offers a different challenge.
instructions:
Desktop: Use the Arrow Keys or WASD to move the ball.

Mobile: Swipe in the direction you want the ball to move.

Cover every available tile to complete the level. If you get stuck, use the hint feature to help find the next move.

title: Lumina Paths — Connect Puzzle
description: Lumina Paths is a relaxing color-matching puzzle. Connect each pair of colored dots with a single unbroken line — no crossing, no overlaps. 125 hand-tuned levels take you from a simple 5×5 grid all the way to an intricate 11×11 challenge, with daily quests, unlockable achievements, and a calm original soundtrack to keep you in the flow.
instructions: Drag from a dot to the matching dot of the same color to draw a path between them. Paths can't cross or overlap — plan your route carefully. Connect every color to clear the level; fill the whole board for a bonus star. Stuck? Use a Hint to reveal the next step, or Undo to take back your last move.

title: Crunch Lock Jam
description: Many wrenches collaborate to create a sophisticated, synchronized performance with many screws in this captivating voyage. This task requires deft sequencing and quick synchronization. Put yourself in the shoes of the unscrewing virtuoso and navigate through a series of heart-pounding trials, injecting each step with an unmatched elegance.
instructions: In this captivating adventure, multiple wrenches choreograph an intricate dance with numerous screws, demanding both nimble coordination and ingenious sequencing. Assume the role of the maestro of unscrewing, infusing each section with an unmatched flair and surging ahead through a series of heart-pounding challenges.

title: Color Cube Puzzle
description:
Color Cube Puzzle is a relaxing logic puzzle where you need to plan every move and position shapes correctly on the board.
Move shapes to the cube conveyors. If the cube color matches the shape color, the shape starts filling with cubes. When a shape is completely filled, it disappears from the level.
instructions:
► Move colored shapes around the board
► Move shapes to the cube conveyors
► If the colors match, the shape will start filling with cubes
► When a shape is fully filled, it disappears
► Fill all shapes to complete the level
► Use boosters if the level is difficult
► Think ahead — wrong moves can block your path

Each level is a new puzzle where planning and the order of actions are important.

title: Spooky Block Blast
description: Spooky Block Blast is an endless block puzzle game where your goal is to survive as long as possible and score as many points as you can. Place spooky shapes on the board and complete full horizontal or vertical lines to clear them and make room for new pieces. Plan each move carefully—as the board fills up, finding space for new shapes becomes increasingly difficult!
instructions:
Three different shapes appear below the board.
Drag and place each shape in any available space.
A new set of three shapes appears only after you place all three current shapes. Complete a full horizontal or vertical line from one edge of the board to the other to clear it.
The game ends when none of the available shapes can be placed.
Try to survive as long as possible and beat your high score!

title: Ocean Bubble Sort
description: It starts simple — just a few bottles and some colors. But soon the ocean grows deeper. Match colors and bring order to chaos as you unlock new themes and designs. With endless levels and boosters to help you, the sea never stops challenging your mind.
instructions: Tap to move colors between bottles until each is complete. Match all shades to finish the level. Stuck? Use boosters like Undo, Extra Bottle or Skip to stay afloat. Earn coins and unlock new ocean themes and bottle skins.

title: Grand Pet Connect
description: Grand Pet Connect is a cute and relaxing tile-matching puzzle filled with adorable animals! Pick pet tiles, collect sets of three identical ones, and watch them disappear. Clear the layered board, plan your moves carefully, and enjoy increasingly challenging levels with your furry and feathered friends!
instructions: Tap an available pet tile to move it into the tray. Match three identical tiles in the tray to remove them and free up space. Clearing tiles reveals new ones underneath, giving you more matching options. Keep making sets of three until the entire board is cleared. Be careful — if the tray fills up before you can make a match, you lose the level. Use helpful boosters to undo moves, shuffle the tiles, or get some help when you're stuck.

title: Color Block Pairs
description:
Move colorful blocks around the board, connect matching colors in pairs, and clear every block to complete the level!
There are no timers and no rush — take your time and plan every move. Frozen and linked blocks, restricted movement paths, and other mechanics turn each level into a new puzzle.
Use boosters whenever you need a little help. Want a higher score? Connect pairs while the combo is active to increase your multiplier.
instructions:
Tap and drag a block to move it around the board. To remove blocks, bring two blocks of the same color together — when they touch, they connect and disappear.
Find a path around other blocks and obstacles, and pay attention to movement restrictions. Some blocks can only move in certain directions, be frozen, or be linked to other blocks.
Your goal is to move and connect all matching pairs until the board is completely clear.

title: Bird Sort
description: Help colorful birds find their flock by sorting them between tree branches. Move birds strategically until every branch contains a complete matching flock. Relax with charming animations, cozy visuals, and satisfying puzzle gameplay that becomes more challenging as you progress.
instructions:
Use mouse or touch:
•	Click or tap a branch to select birds.
•	Click or tap a highlighted branch to move them.
•	Complete every branch by grouping matching birds together.

title: Cannon Smash Fest
description:
Welcome to Cannon Smash Fest — a fun physics-based destruction game where every cannon shot creates a satisfying chain reaction!

Load your cannon, adjust the perfect angle and power, and blast through challenging levels. Destroy fragile jars, break heavy stone blocks, and knock down massive structures with realistic physics. Plan each shot carefully to clear every obstacle using as few cannonballs as possible.
Easy to learn, fun to master, and packed with satisfying destruction!
instructions:
Drag the mouse to aim the cannon.
Release the left mouse button to fire.

title: Geometry Overlap
description: A minimalist shape matching puzzle. Drag black geometric pieces onto the target circle overlapping shapes cancel to white until you recreate the goal exactly.
instructions: Mouse / Touch

title: Pixel Tetrix Trails
description: Join a cheerful artist and rebuild colorful pixel-art pictures from glossy Tetrix-style pieces. Drag every block into its correct place, reveal the completed artwork, and finish before time runs out. Explore 90 handcrafted levels with satisfying placement feedback, cozy studio visuals, and increasingly challenging shapes
instructions: Drag a piece using the mouse or touchscreen and move it over the picture. Valid positions show a positive highlight, while invalid positions show a warning highlight. Release the piece when it fits correctly. Complete every cell before the timer reaches zero. Use Hint to reveal the correct location of one unplaced piece.

title: Sorting Games Toy Sort
description: Sorting Games Toy Sort is a fun toy sorting and triple match puzzle game that combines colorful dolls, clever organization, and exciting timed challenges into one addictive experience. Every level introduces fresh layouts and new challenges, making this addictive sort puzzle game enjoyable from beginning to end.
instructions: Click and drag: Play.

title: Water Flow Puzzle
description: Water Flow Puzzle is a relaxing brain teaser all about the flow of water. Drag the numbered pieces into place to connect the faucet through a maze of pipes, then watch the water rise and fill every flask in the right order. Easy to learn but tricky to master, each level is a satisfying logic challenge packed with bombs, locked tanks, one-way valves and clever twists. No timer, no pressure — just calm, bubbly puzzles. How far can you make the water flow?
instructions: Drag the numbered pieces from the tray and drop them into the empty slots to connect the pipes, then fill each flask in the correct order to solve the puzzle. Mouse: click and drag. Touch: tap, drag and release. Tap the Hint button if you get stuck.

title: Fashion Closet Sort
description: Step into a stylish boutique and bring order to every closet! Move the rightmost garment between closets and group four matching clothing types together. Sort dresses, skinny jeans, jackets, tops, skirts, shorts, hoodies, and coats across 90 increasingly challenging levels. Beat the timer, use helpful boosters, and enjoy polished fashion-themed visuals and satisfying sounds.
instructions: Tap a closet to select its rightmost garment, then tap another closet to move it. A garment can be placed in an empty closet or in a closet whose rightmost garment is the same clothing type, provided space is available. Complete every clothing category before the timer reaches zero. Use Hint to reveal a valid move and Extra Closet to add sorting space.

title: Arrow Rescue
description:
Cute animals are trapped inside dangerous mazes, and only your strategy can save them! 

Pull arrows in the correct order to remove obstacles, unlock hidden paths, and guide every animal to safety. 

Each puzzle introduces new challenges that test your logic and planning. 

With relaxing gameplay, colorful visuals, and hundreds of handcrafted levels, every rescue is both rewarding and satisfying. 

Think carefully, choose wisely, and become the hero every animal is waiting for!
instructions:
• Tap and pull arrows to change the maze.
• Remove obstacles in the correct order.
• Open a safe route for the trapped animals.
• Avoid blocking the only escape path.
• Plan every move before taking action.
• Rescue every animal to unlock more challenging puzzles and explore new levels.

Easy to learn but challenging to master—every level rewards smart thinking and careful planning.

title: Animal Pair Card Match
description: Animal Pair Card Match is a charming matching puzzle game that combines cute animal cards and relaxing elimination gameplay. In this delightful matching puzzle game, your task is to find animal pairs by opening two cards at a time and matching the same animal images. Each successful match helps you collect target animals and clear the board. When the challenge becomes tricky, useful tools can provide extra help and guide you toward victory.
instructions: Click and drag to play.

title: Cozy Puzzle: Cats
description:
Fit shapes onto the board, discover new cats, complete levels, and earn daily rewards.
A cozy puzzle game where every cat-shaped piece needs to find its perfect place on the board. Drag pieces, rotate them, and build complete compositions. Progress through a large campaign, meet new cats, and grow your collection.
instructions:
Drag cat-shaped pieces from the bottom of the screen onto the board. Place them so they fill the empty cells without overlapping or going outside the borders. Click a piece to rotate it, then keep dragging it into position.
Complete a level by fitting every piece into the correct place. The cleaner your solution and the fewer extra moves you make, the more stars you earn. Unlock new campaign levels, try random puzzles, and complete daily and weekly challenges.

title: Mahjong Match Line
description: Mahjong Match Line is a relaxing tile-matching puzzle inspired by classic Mahjong. Move tiles horizontally and vertically across the board to bring identical tiles together and merge them. Plan each move carefully, clear the board, and enjoy increasingly challenging levels in a peaceful atmosphere.
instructions:
Select a tile and move it horizontally or vertically.
Bring two identical tiles together to merge and remove them.
Use the empty spaces to reposition tiles and create new matches.
Clear all the tiles to complete the level.

title: Color Path Puzzle
description:
Color Path Puzzle is a bright and engaging logic game where every move matters.

Move shapes across the board, follow the color clues, and guide each puzzle piece through the right zones. To complete a level, you need to choose the correct path and move all shapes out of the field.

The rules are simple: shapes can pass through areas that match their color. But with each new level, you will need to think more carefully and plan every move.
instructions:
Your goal is to move all shapes out of the game field.

Move the shapes across the level and use color clues to find the right path. Each shape should pass through zones that match its color.

On a computer, control the game with the mouse or keyboard. On a phone, use swipes.

Think ahead, clear the board, and complete new levels one by one.

title: Mystic Word Quests
description: Sharpen your mind in this fun word search puzzle! Find all the hidden words by scanning the letter board and selecting each one before moving to the next challenge. Test your vocabulary, observation skills, and speed across increasingly tricky levels.
instructions: Find the hidden words on the board and drag across the letters to mark them. Words can be formed horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, in both forward and backward directions.

title: Threads
description:
In this game, you untangle pieces of fabric and wind them onto matching colored spools. Fabric falls from above, and your task is to correctly place spools so each thread is collected by its matching color.
Each level becomes more challenging: more colors appear, the speed increases, and combinations become more complex. You need to make quick decisions and carefully plan your moves to avoid mistakes.
instructions:
In this game, your goal is to untangle pieces of fabric and correctly distribute them onto matching spools. On each level, fabric pieces of different colors fall from the top, while spools are placed at the bottom.
Your task is to match each fabric color with the correct spool. If the match is correct, the fabric is automatically wound onto the spool. If you make a mistake, the level becomes more challenging and requires more careful planning.

title: Duotrace
description:
Duotrace is a chill but sneaky-tricky puzzle game. The rule is simple: trace every line in the shape exactly twice without lifting your finger. Sounds easy, until the shapes get tangled and you have to think ahead to find the path that works.

What sets it apart is that double-trace twist. A small rule that becomes a real brain teaser, with a great "aha, got it!" feeling once you crack a level.
instructions:
Left Click/Tap: Select the next connected node and draw a line to it.
Pause Button: Pause or resume the game.
Reset Button: Restart the current level from scratch.
Hint Button: Get a free hint (limited uses), or watch a short ad for an extra hint.

title: Block Slide
description: Block Slide is a minimalist sliding block puzzler. Swipe or press an arrow key and every block slides until it hits a wall or another block get each onto its matching target to clear the level. 130 levels introduce mechanics gradually: teleporters, arrow tiles, sticky blocks, pins, pressure traps, rotators, conveyors, and multi-board levels solved in parallel. Play on desktop or mobile portrait and landscape adapt automatically.
instructions: Swipe (touch) or Arrow Keys / WASD (keyboard) to slide all blocks in that direction. Press R to restart a level, ESC or the menu button to return to level select, Spacebar for next level.

title: Animals Arrow
description: Animals Arrows is a fun and addictive minimalist puzzle game that challenges your logic, memory, and focus with brain-teasing levels.
instructions:
Study the arrows on the board.
Follow the direction each arrow points.
Choose the correct path without making mistakes.
Complete the objective to finish the level.
As you progress, more arrows and complex patterns will appear.
Use logic, observation, and planning to solve every puzzle.

title: Heist Crew
description: Heist Crew is a fast-paced bank heist strategy and action game where you control a crew of specialists and pull off increasingly challenging robberies. Switch between crew members, hack secured doors, disable security systems, avoid guards and cameras, crack vaults, collect the loot, and escape in your getaway vehicle. Each job introduces tougher security and new challenges, rewarding careful planning, stealth, timing, and quick decisions.
instructions: Choose a crew member and complete the objectives shown during each heist. Use Pixel to hack doors, security systems, and vaults. Use Brick to deal with guards and carry loot efficiently. Load stolen bags into the getaway vehicle and escape the area to complete the job. Stay out of guards' vision, avoid cameras and lasers, and react quickly if the alarm is triggered. On mobile, use the on-screen controls. On desktop, use the displayed keyboard controls and action buttons.

title: Jelly Yeet!
description: Launch a bouncy jelly from the backyard into space! Time your swing for a perfect hit, bounce off trampolines, bump into airborne objects, and travel through portals. Use your mid-air slam to keep the action going, earn coins, and upgrade your power, bounce, and slam. Unlock funny jelly skins and unique clubs, then chase your next distance record!
instructions:
Click, tap, or press Space to stop the timing meter and launch your jelly. Aim for the perfect zone for a stronger shot!

During flight, click, tap, or press Space again to use your slam once per launch. Hit springy objects for powerful bounces.

Earn coins to buy upgrades and unlock jelly skins and clubs. On mobile, turn your device sideways to play in landscape mode.

title: Cursed gift
description:
Death is not the end—it is only the beginning of your rise. You have been brought back to life by the very embodiment of Death to become the last hope of a dying kingdom. The lands are ravaged by insane cultists and the possessed, and only a true Lord of the Dead can restore order here.
Lead the Legions of Darkness: raise fallen enemies, making them part of your undead army, and combine squads of skeletons, zombies, and mighty liches.

WASD — move your character.
Q, E, R, F — activate abilities.
Hold C to open the potion wheel and select one.
LMB — interact, select a unit squad.
Hold LMB and move the mouse to drag a selection area and choose multiple squads.
RMB — issue an order to selected units.
Esc — pause.

title: Flying Robot Transform Car Game

Mobile

title: ENDLESS
description:
Run up the endless stairs!
Tap or hold the Climb button to climb.
Press the Turn button to change direction.
Don’t slow down, or the monster will catch you!
Turn the wrong way, and it’s game over.
Magic Flask: Climb with only the Climb button for a limited time.
Blue Lantern: Makes the monster disappear for a limited time.
instructions:
Tap repeatedly or hold the Climb button to climb the stairs.
Press the Turn button to change direction.

title: terror in backrooms valley
description:
Terror in Backrooms Valley is a cinematic horror visual novel where every decision can change your fate.

You awaken inside an impossible place filled with endless yellow corridors, abandoned motels, flooded tunnels, forgotten research rooms, and a mysterious valley hidden beyond reality. As you search for a way out, you meet strange survivors, uncover disturbing clues, and discover that the Backrooms may know more about your past than you do.

description:
Welcome to Dice Hero, a unique fantasy adventure where every dice roll shapes your destiny. Discover powerful runes, create devastating dice combinations, defeat dangerous monsters, upgrade your hero and rebuild eight unique worlds.
? Master the Dice
Roll your dice to unleash powerful attacks and discover countless ways to defeat your enemies.
? Battle Epic Monsters
Fight through dangerous fantasy worlds filled with unique enemies and powerful bosses.

Lumen Ruin Runner is a fast-paced arcade adventure where you run,
jump, dodge hazards, collect energy, and unlock your way through
challenging levels.
instructions:
Use the keyboard to move and jump. Avoid hazards, collect energy,
and reach the end of each level.

title: Sea Survivor
description: Survive endless waves of enemy ships in an epic three-D top-down sea battle. Fire powerful cannons, collect loot, upgrade your ship, and use smart strategy to become the ultimate sea warrior.
instructions:
Controls

Mobile: Use the on-screen joystick to control your ship.

title: SUMI
description:
You are a ball.
There are other balls.
You have to shoot them.

Survive. Get stronger. Go further. And most importantly get the highest score you possibly can.

Designed to be simple, relaxing, and easy to pick up, but surviving for a long time won't be quite as easy as it seems.

How long can you survive?
instructions:
Move: WASD
Shoot: Hold the Left Mouse Button
Pause: P, Esc
Goal: Destroy enemies, survive as long as possible, and get the highest score.

title: Duck Family Simulator Animal Games
description: Experience the exciting life of a wild duck in Duck Family Simulator Animal Games! Explore beautiful islands, peaceful lakes, and lush green forests while raising your duck family and surviving against dangerous predators. Hunt for food, protect your ducklings, complete thrilling missions, and discover the adventures of life in the wild.

Techniques are typed as sequences. Charge (J→K) is yours from the start; the rest drop as manuals from elites and bosses. The bar at the bottom of the screen always shows how far into a sequence you are.

Touch is supported: a floating stick on the left, four action buttons on the right.

title: Super Hero Survivor Io
description: Step into an explosive battlefield where chaos never stops in Super Hero Survivor Io! This fast-paced survival adventure throws you into endless waves of enemies across mysterious zones, blending intense combat, upgrades, and hero evolution into one thrilling experience. If you love fast reflex gameplay with constant action, this title delivers the ultimate Zombie survival IO excitement.

title: Boys vs Girls
description:
Welcome to the most dramatic school on Earth, where every minor inconvenience is treated like an international crisis.

The classroom becomes a battlefield as boys and girls compete over the dumbest things imaginable. Who should be class president? Who started that ridiculous rumor? Who gets the last snack? Why is someone campaigning with free candy? Somehow, every argument escalates into complete and utter chaos.
instructions: A funny interactive school story about rivalry, rumors, choices, detention, and class election chaos.

title: Shadows of the Forest: Reign of Triduja

Your only way out is to complete a mysterious Totem. Explore the surrounding woods to locate the hidden fragments and solve the puzzle. Stay alert—you aren’t alone in these woods.

description: Scale the Depths brings you into a peaceful underwater adventure where fishing becomes a relaxing and rewarding experience. This charming fishing game lets you explore quiet oceans, cast your hook, discover different sea creatures, and enjoy a simple catch-and-feed journey. If you love fishing simulator games, relaxing ocean exploration, and calming collection gameplay, this underwater world is waiting for you!
instructions: Choose a location and send your hook into the water. Move carefully through the depths and try to catch different types of fish and sea creatures. Bring your catches back and gather different resources from the ocean. Go to the kitchen area, clean the fish by removing scales, and turn them into meat.

title: Breakthrough Team
description: Begin an explosive adventure in Breakthrough Team, a thrilling mix of action, intense battle, and addictive tower defense gameplay. In this fast-paced game, you must build powerful defenses, deploy unique heroes, and command your team to break through waves of enemies.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

description:
Ready to challenge endless hordes of monsters? Up Hero is an action-packed RPG where you level up and power up your character right on the battlefield. Wipe out waves of enemies and prove that you are the ultimate hero!
What awaits you in Up Hero:
Horde Battles: Fight your way through crowds of monsters!
Vast Arsenal & Epic Skills: Mix and match swords, firearms, and magic!
Dangerous Worlds: Explore unique locations, each with its own monsters and bosses!
instructions:
Controls: On PC, move your hero using WASD or arrow keys. On mobile, simply drag your finger anywhere on the screen (virtual joystick).
Auto-Combat: No need to mash attack buttons! Your character automatically strikes monsters as soon as they get close. Just maneuver through the crowd and dodge threats.
Gather Resources & Cargo: Explore locations, chop wood, mine stone, deliver valuable cargo, and collect gold dropped by defeated enemies.

title: 12 Minute Escape
description: Repair the ancient portal and escape before time runs out! Defeat slimes, gather magical resources, build powerful structures, unlock new wizard characters, and survive exciting world events. Every minute brings new opportunities with Golden Rush, Treasure Hunt, and Wizard Frenzy. Plan your upgrades wisely, grow stronger, and see if you can escape within 12 minutes! Beware the Slime King!

title: Brick Breaker
description: Smash bricks in this fast-paced Arkanoid-style arcade classic! Aim, launch, and chain massive combos with NICE, GREAT, AWESOME, and INSANE streaks. Collect 5 power-ups: Extra Ball, Double Ball, Bomb Shot, HP Reduce, and Shield. Battle through 100 stages with unique layouts and epic boss fights every 10 levels. Bricks descend each turn — don't let them reach the bottom! Neon-glow visuals, smooth controls, and endless replayability. Can you reach Stage 100?
instructions:
Arrow Keys: Aim left / right
Space or Enter: Launch balls
ESC: Pause menu
Mouse: Click and drag to aim, click to shoot
Touch: Tap and swipe to aim on mobile devices
Destroy all bricks to clear the stage. Collect falling power-ups for bonus abilities. Don't let bricks reach the bottom!

title: Cyber Rolling Going Ball 3D
description: Begin an electrifying rolling adventure in Cyber Rolling - Going Ball 3D! This thrilling ball platformer puts your reflexes, timing, and precision to the ultimate test. Fans of exciting arcade games and fast-paced obstacle challenges will instantly feel at home. This is a Going Ball online experience and crazy roll 3d unblocked that can be enjoyed directly.
instructions: Keep swiping for max speed.

title: Escape the Alien Prison
description:
You have suddenly woken up trapped inside a massive, high-tech spaceship deep in the cosmos, and there is only one objective: break out! Escape the Alien Prison is an epic sci-fi survival and parkour adventure where you must fight your way to freedom. Navigate dangerous obstacle courses, hack complex security systems, and take down extraterrestrial threats. 
The complete story campaign, puzzles, collectibles, and progression are available in Single Player Mode.
instructions:
Move: Use the W, A, S, D keys.
Jump: Press the Spacebar (Press twice for a Double Jump!).
Sprint: Hold Left Shift to run fast.
Attack / Shoot: Press F or the Right Mouse Button.
Interact: Press E to hack panels and open doors.
Change Weapons: Use the 1, 2, 3, 4 number keys.

title: Zombie Conquer Countries
description: In Zombie Conquer Countries, you’ll start with just a handful of infected zombies and gradually sweep through cities, expanding your territory until the entire map becomes your domain. Every successful infection will rapidly grow your army, creating an unstoppable rush of expansion! The game combines expansion mechanics with satisfying progression, creating an addictive experience for fans of zombie games.
instructions: Click and drag: Play.

title: Archer: Dungeon Hero
description: A fast-paced fantasy roguelike where an archer battles waves of monsters, unlocks abilities, and creates a unique build during every run.

Control your hero using the virtual joystick or keyboard controls.
Keep your distance from enemies, dodge incoming projectiles, and attack whenever you find a safe opportunity. Defeat monsters, collect experience, and choose new abilities when you level up.
Clear every room, open treasure chests, and defeat powerful bosses. Between runs, equip better items and improve your hero’s permanent stats.

title: Mononinja
description:
Make precise jumps while avoiding certain death. Guide a brave ninja to his goal as he overcomes his deadly obstacles. Over 30 levels filled with fun and challenge. Are you up for the challenge?

Only one way to find out if you truly have what it takes to be a shinobi.

On Mobile, tap and hold the screen to jump.

The longer you hold the jump button the higher the jump.

Step into the exciting world of virtual pet adventures with the Family Pet Dog Simulator!

Experience the joy of living with a cute and loyal puppy as you help your virtual family in daily home and neighborhood activities. Play as a lovable family dog and assist virtual mom with cleaning the messy house, completing household chores, and helping neighbours in this fun filled dog simulator game.

Break pots, steal fish from the aquarium, throw things and scratch everything that comes under your paw. And all this is in the form of a first-person simulator with elements of humor and mayhem.

title: Worm Puzzle Snake Apple

With funny snake movements and playful interactions, it brings a strong Funny vibe while still offering smart puzzle challenges. Fans of casual games enjoy its relaxing pace, while puzzle lovers enjoy the deep puzzle design. It also offers a calming relaxation flow with surprising twists in every level.

title: SKYHILL: Escape From the Skyscraper!

A desperate biological attack by the losing Confederates caught everyone by surprise. Something happened that no one could have imagined. They launched hundreds of missiles and plunged the entire world, including themselves, into chaos.

To survive, you need to eat and monitor your energy expenditure.
Find supplies, weapons, and fight monsters.
Just survive =)
